Sentence (English): After struggling with hand-washing dishes three times a day, I finally bought the LG Dios Objet Collection built-in dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ It is definitely said to be typical of LG. ] || ---------------- || After struggling with hand-washing dishes three times a day, I finally bought the LG Dios Objet Collection built-in dishwasher. To cut to the chase, I'm now wondering why I waited so long to buy it. It seats 14 people, so it has ample storage space, allowing me to wash pots, pans, glasses, and even lunch boxes all at once. Even when fully loaded, it comes out sparkling clean without water stains. The dishwashing power is truly LG-like. The True Steam function is especially helpful when washing glasses and baby food. It's virtually silent, so you can run it at night without any problems. It even dries perfectly, so you can just put it away in the morning! The clean, Objet Collection design blends seamlessly into your kitchen interior. When the door is closed, it looks like furniture, adding to the overall aesthetic. The only downside is that you need to measure the built-in space precisely when installing it. Because of its size, you'll definitely need to consult with an installer to ensure it fits your existing sink. Adjusting the amount of detergent can be confusing at first, but after a few uses, you'll quickly get the hang of it. Overall, this appliance scores 100 points for design, cleaning power, noise reduction, and convenience. Product support has been amazing as my initial broken Beko dishwasher was warrantied and replaced the very next day.I have now had a broken Miele dishwasher for 1 month, and their support technician just missed the scheduled repair date. I now see I have two missed calls right at the end of the window, but my phone definitely did not ring. They were supposed to call half an hour before arriving, which they most certainly did not. I was sitting in my living room. Supposedly, he knocked on the door, but I have never had any trouble hearing any other tradesmen if they knock or give a shout. Guessing he knocked softly and just chilled in his car for 20 minutes.Miele feels highly bureaucratic, call service is clearly oversees. I was transferred 4 times talking with them just to inform them their technician was a no show.Bureaucracy and marketing are where they high purchase costs are going; not actually quality products or service. I am tired of the dramatic, "Oh, I am soooo sorry", dramatic line every single rep is drilled to use. I guess we will see if they make an actual effort next week. And I highly doubt my dishwasher will actually be fixed next week.-----We have used this new dishwasher for 4 months.A month ago, it threw an error code; water in the bottom of the dishwasher. Asked the internet. Tip it forward to get the water out, it may work again. It did.A month later it has thrown an F78 error. I checked the filter, watched internet videos, checked the water hose and plumbing. Nothing works.Soonest appointment is 3 weeks away; not ideal. I am under warranty, so there is no cost. But. the terms and conditions quoted $399 callout fee, and $160 per hour as their standard repair rates, which I would consider extortionate.I have installed 20 or so dishwashers, and this has got to be the most fragile, temperamental dishwasher I have ever used. I have now purchased a Beko 1650, which comes free with a 5 year warranty, as a replacement until our Miele is repaired. I soured on Bosch after two units failed just outside their 2 year warranty. Our previous Bosch was still working at 20 years of age (Made in Turkey even).I <3 my Miele dishwasher. The rack organisation lets me easily fit in large bowls or pots, and is so well engineered. And out of a test and curiosity, I started throwing in my bowls with flakes of days or week old oatmeal stuck on, expecting it of course not to clean. Amazingly, they came back clean, using the pot and pan cycle. You can hear the jets hitting pots and pans, as if they use a good amount of pressure. The filter also seems to get less gunked up with stuff, and needs less cleaning. I love this as who wants their wash and rinse water filtered through disgusting, month old food ooze. Yuck.I guess that's the thing. I have read many people now saying Miele's reliability is not what it used to be. At 45, I have never had a dishwasher throw 2 major faults in 6 months. So, maybe I'm the outlier, but this is less likely.I was going to give 3 stars, but I'll make it 4 due to product quality (not reliability) and the chance I got one with a lemon pump. But this is not an impressive start, I've already had to buy a 2nd dishwasher, and I no longer trust Miele's reliability or for this product to last the 10 years it should, much less even 5. If this product fails in less than 5 years, I'll be updating this to 2 stars. The engineering is beautiful. I hope it will actually be reliable after the repair.I would trust other people's advice that only the Miele dishwashers are worth it, not their other products. Not that their other products are bad, but the dishwashers are exceptional and actually worth the cost premium. We just replaced a Bosch washing machine of 12 years with Westinghouse washer and a top of the line heat pump Electrolux drier. The Bosch was still working.I would agree with comments of read that Miele and Bosch have pulled a Mercedes, and put their budgets into marketing and cut back on R & D. I'm done with German stuff, after being a Bosch customer for life. They can't compete with the Chinese on cost, so the Germans have lowered their price points, but probably cut corners on engineering and reliability to achieve it. Mercedes sit 2nd from the bottom on Consumer Reports reliability index, only above Jeep.Westinghouse looks to have 3 dishwashers for sale that are 10 years dated and look cheap. Bosch ones are the same unless you spend $1600. And 2 year warranties. Come on! I may regret buying a Beko, but it comes with a 5 year standard warranty, Choice has recommended Beko, and their cleaning score was at the top with half a dozen other major brands including Miele; their 1640, and presumably 1650 mind you. Beko has poor reviews, and are Turkish. But being burned on Bosch and no longer trusting our new Miele's reliability, I may as well get something with nice features and a 5 year warranty for a 2nd dishwasher, that apparently cleans well.Australia is getting treated as a dumping ground for old dishwasher models. Haier dishwashers are junk, tried it. Bosch and Westinghouse are selling years dated models. Bosch and Westinghouse still using dated analogue buttons, save Bosch's most expensive stuff. Every LG product I have owned has broken or has some serious flaw. Trying Beko, not because I'm optimistic, but because everyone else has burned me or is taking us for a ride offering dated models at high prices.I hope my Miele dishwasher ends up lasting 10+ years, because I truly love it. But I no longer trust it's reliability. If the whole Internet was not full of Miele customers saying the same thing, I would be more optimistic. And Westinghouse's products for get good reviews and are reliable. It's a shame they are still selling a 10 year outdated model with cheap racks. Their clothes washer and Electrolux (Westinghouse) drier we bought are incredible and highly technological.I will update this review in a few years regarding whether my Miele lasts, or as likely, does not.Also, customer support felt bureaucratic, inefficient, highly vertically integrated, and overly dramatic. "Oh. We are so sorry this happened to you. Oh we are so sorry your dishwasher isn't working." That's not on the poor reps at the bottom ordered to do this. 3 weeks for a technician that probably won't fix my dishwasher on the day is not good enough. Nor is a $399 callout fee and $160 an hour. It is pretty clear a decent chunk of the Miele high price tag is going to support a structurally inefficient company. If their products were both high quality and reliable, I would tolerate it.This will be our first and last Miele product if this thing does not last the distance, and I unfortunately have no reason to think it will. This is the first time I have ever had to buy a substitute dishwasher, the first time a dishwasher has ever failed in less than 2 years, twice at 4 months. I'll put up with these annoyances if the product is amazing and reliable. It is amazing engineering wise. but I doubt it will be reliable. I hope I am wrong.

I'll put up with these annoyances if the product is amazing and reliable. It is amazing engineering wise... but I doubt it will be reliable. I hope I am wrong.

This is the first time I have ever had to buy a substitute dishwasher, the first time a dishwasher has ever failed in less than 2 years, twice at 4 months. I'll put up with these annoyances if the product is amazing and reliable. It is amazing engineering wise... but I doubt it will be reliable. I hope I am wrong.

Guessing he knocked softly and just chilled in his car for 20 minutes.Miele feels highly bureaucratic, call service is clearly oversees. I was transferred 4 times talking with them just to inform them their technician was a no show.Bureaucracy and marketing are where they high purchase costs are going; not actually quality products or service. I am tired of the dramatic, 'Oh, I am soooo sorry', dramatic line every single rep is drilled to use. I guess we will see if they make an actual effort next week. And I highly doubt my dishwasher will actually be fixed next week.-----We have used this new dishwasher for 4 months.A month ago, it threw an error code; water in the bottom of the dishwasher. Asked the internet. Tip it forward to get the water out, it may work again. It did.A month later it has thrown an F78 error. 'Oh. We are so sorry this happened to you. Oh we are so sorry your dishwasher isn't working.' That's not on the poor reps at the bottom ordered to do this. 3 weeks for a technician that probably won't fix my dishwasher on the day is not good enough. Nor is a $399 callout fee and $160 an hour. It is pretty clear a decent chunk of the Miele high price tag is going to support a structurally inefficient company. If their products were both high quality and reliable, I would tolerate it.This will be our first and last Miele product if this thing does not last the distance, and I unfortunately have no reason to think it will. This is the first time I have ever had to buy a substitute dishwasher, the first time a dishwasher has ever failed in less than 2 years, twice at 4 months. I'll put up with these annoyances if the product is amazing and reliable. It is amazing engineering wise... but I doubt it will be reliable. I hope I am wrong.

Product support has been amazing as my initial broken Beko dishwasher was warrantied and replaced the very next day.I have now had a broken Miele dishwasher for 1 month, and their support technician just missed the scheduled repair date. I now see I have two missed calls right at the end of the window, but my phone definitely did not ring. They were supposed to call half an hour before arriving, which they most certainly did not. I was sitting in my living room. Supposedly, he knocked on the door, but I have never had any trouble hearing any other tradesmen if they knock or give a shout. Guessing he knocked softly and just chilled in his car for 20 minutes.Miele feels highly bureaucratic, call service is clearly oversees. I was transferred 4 times talking with them just to inform them their technician was a no show.Bureaucracy and marketing are where they high purchase costs are going; not actually quality products or service. I am tired of the dramatic, "Oh, I am soooo sorry", dramatic line every single rep is drilled to use. I guess we will see if they make an actual effort next week. And I highly doubt my dishwasher will actually be fixed next week.-----We have used this new dishwasher for 4 months.A month ago, it threw an error code; water in the bottom of the dishwasher. Asked the internet. Tip it forward to get the water out, it may work again. It did.A month later it has thrown an F78 error. I checked the filter, watched internet videos, checked the water hose and plumbing. Nothing works.Soonest appointment is 3 weeks away; not ideal. I am under warranty, so there is no cost. But. the terms and conditions quoted $399 callout fee, and $160 per hour as their standard repair rates, which I would consider extortionate.I have installed 20 or so dishwashers, and this has got to be the most fragile, temperamental dishwasher I have ever used. I have now purchased a Beko 1650, which comes free with a 5 year warranty, as a replacement until our Miele is repaired. I soured on Bosch after two units failed just outside their 2 year warranty. Our previous Bosch was still working at 20 years of age (Made in Turkey even).I <3 my Miele dishwasher. The rack organisation lets me easily fit in large bowls or pots, and is so well engineered. And out of a test and curiosity, I started throwing in my bowls with flakes of days or week old oatmeal stuck on, expecting it of course not to clean. Amazingly, they came back clean, using the pot and pan cycle. You can hear the jets hitting pots and pans, as if they use a good amount of pressure. The filter also seems to get less gunked up with stuff, and needs less cleaning. I love this as who wants their wash and rinse water filtered through disgusting, month old food ooze. Yuck.I guess that's the thing. I have read many people now saying Miele's reliability is not what it used to be. At 45, I have never had a dishwasher throw 2 major faults in 6 months. So, maybe I'm the outlier, but this is less likely.I was going to give 3 stars, but I'll make it 4 due to product quality (not reliability) and the chance I got one with a lemon pump. But this is not an impressive start, I've already had to buy a 2nd dishwasher, and I no longer trust Miele's reliability or for this product to last the 10 years it should, much less even 5. If this product fails in less than 5 years, I'll be updating this to 2 stars. The engineering is beautiful. I hope it will actually be reliable after the repair.I would trust other people's advice that only the Miele dishwashers are worth it, not their other products. Not that their other products are bad, but the dishwashers are exceptional and actually worth the cost premium. We just replaced a Bosch washing machine of 12 years with Westinghouse washer and a top of the line heat pump Electrolux drier. The Bosch was still working.I would agree with comments of read that Miele and Bosch have pulled a Mercedes, and put their budgets into marketing and cut back on R & D. I'm done with German stuff, after being a Bosch customer for life. They can't compete with the Chinese on cost, so the Germans have lowered their price points, but probably cut corners on engineering and reliability to achieve it. Mercedes sit 2nd from the bottom on Consumer Reports reliability index, only above Jeep.Westinghouse looks to have 3 dishwashers for sale that are 10 years dated and look cheap. Bosch ones are the same unless you spend $1600. And 2 year warranties. Come on! I may regret buying a Beko, but it comes with a 5 year standard warranty, Choice has recommended Beko, and their cleaning score was at the top with half a dozen other major brands including Miele; their 1640, and presumably 1650 mind you. Beko has poor reviews, and are Turkish. But being burned on Bosch and no longer trusting our new Miele's reliability, I may as well get something with nice features and a 5 year warranty for a 2nd dishwasher, that apparently cleans well.Australia is getting treated as a dumping ground for old dishwasher models. Haier dishwashers are junk, tried it. Bosch and Westinghouse are selling years dated models. Bosch and Westinghouse still using dated analogue buttons, save Bosch's most expensive stuff. Every LG product I have owned has broken or has some serious flaw. Trying Beko, not because I'm optimistic, but because everyone else has burned me or is taking us for a ride offering dated models at high prices.I hope my Miele dishwasher ends up lasting 10+ years, because I truly love it. But I no longer trust it's reliability. If the whole Internet was not full of Miele customers saying the same thing, I would be more optimistic. And Westinghouse's products for get good reviews and are reliable. It's a shame they are still selling a 10 year outdated model with cheap racks. Their clothes washer and Electrolux (Westinghouse) drier we bought are incredible and highly technological.I will update this review in a few years regarding whether my Miele lasts, or as likely, does not.Also, customer support felt bureaucratic, inefficient, highly vertically integrated, and overly dramatic. "Oh. We are so sorry this happened to you. Oh we are so sorry your dishwasher isn't working." That's not on the poor reps at the bottom ordered to do this. 3 weeks for a technician that probably won't fix my dishwasher on the day is not good enough. Nor is a $399 callout fee and $160 an hour. It is pretty clear a decent chunk of the Miele high price tag is going to support a structurally inefficient company. If their products were both high quality and reliable, I would tolerate it.This will be our first and last Miele product if this thing does not last the distance, and I unfortunately have no reason to think it will. This is the first time I have ever had to buy a substitute dishwasher, the first time a dishwasher has ever failed in less than 2 years, twice at 4 months. I'll put up with these annoyances if the product is amazing and reliable. It is amazing engineering wise. but I doubt it will be reliable. I hope I am wrong.

I tested it on some pans with stuck on eggs and pasta sauce and they came out totally clean! With my old dishwasher I would have had to scrub or run it a couple of times. It is also VERY quiet! It has a ProDry setting and it will crack the door to release the steam at the end of the cycle. I am a little disappointed in the functionality of the third rack (very top). Most of my cups and mugs aren't able to fit up there and it never gets completely dry. The utensil basket on the bottom rack is nice and large. There are also dedicated spaces to support stemmed wine glasses with hooks that fold down. If you're looking to get a new dishwasher, this one is worth checking out! Just be aware that it may not give you as much extra space as you would think with three racks. Pros: efficient clean, multiple wash/dry settings, large utensil basketCons: Poor design for third rack, top rack doesn't dry as well

We are already thrilled that we've made this purchase, and hope to have this appliance for at least a decade or more.

Replacement of the filter fixed that, but this shouldn't be happening to a dishwasher less than two years old (of course, the warranty for these parts is only one year).

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher a few days ago and are very satisfied.
Comments (English): [ Washes and dries impeccably ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher a few days ago and are very satisfied. It washes and dries perfectly, removes dirt without having to pre-wash, and if you select the right options, the dishes come out perfectly dry and shiny. The mobile app is also useful for expanding programs and simplifying option selection. Although we came from a high-end model and missed details like the old salt filler in the door (something that's no longer available), the overall rating is excellent. A recommended purchase.

Aunque veníamos de un modelo de gama alta y echamos de menos detalles como la antigua carga de sal en la puerta (algo que ya no se encuentra), la valoración general es excelente. Una compra recomendable.

Sentence (English): This is my first dishwasher purchase.
Comments (English): This is my first dishwasher purchase. I hesitated because I didn't have the confidence to empty the drawers, but I hesitated until the day of installation, and finally bought it. The upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I was planning to put up a sheet, and the nature beige color looked good, so I chose it. The price difference between the hot air dryer and the dryer function was 200,000-300,000 won, but a friend insisted on buying the latest model, so I made my choice. Removing the existing drawers was no easy task, but the technician was so skilled that he did it all by himself. (Removal fee: 30,000 won) After emptying the drawers and opening the dishwasher box, I found that there was moisture inside. They said it was normal for the water to be there because it had been tested before delivery! 0_ 0\" In the test, you said that the moisture would be gone after 2 weeks of opening it, but mine seemed to have been tested only a few days ago. Mode types: automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air is optional), normal mode (hot air is optional), powerful mode, quiet mode, drying mode only, download mode. In addition, there are steam, rinse, sterilization, hot air, reservation, and remote modes. You can select the number of times or time for rinse and hot air. I tried the 1-hour mode for the first time and ran it on the hot air mode for 40 minutes, but there was quite a bit of moisture. The next time I tried the automatic mode, the moisture was reduced a lot, but there was still water in the dent at the back of the cup. I'm still in the process of getting used to the dishwasher, so it's not like 'This is really good. '. But my aunt is right, once you get used to it, there are definitely advantages. I'm still lacking the know-how to put in plates and bowls, so I'm still in the adjustment period. It seems simple, but I can't put them in roughly because I'm afraid it'll rattle when I use it;;; Salt is used depending on the region, but it's not necessarily salt from the beginning. They said I didn't have to do it and that I had to use conditioner. I bought a classic tab detergent and decided to use conditioner. When I briefly ran it for an hour, a bE error popped up, so I looked it up and found out it was a rinse failure error due to excessive foam. I was confused because I had selected a low number of rinses, but anyway, the self-treatment method that came up was to put a bowl of milk on it and run it, which said that the foam would disappear, so I did that and it started working normally again. I'm still in the adjustment period, so it's hard to get used to it.
Comments (Original): 식세기 첫구매. 그동안 서랍장을 비울 자신이 없어서 망설였는데 설치당일까지도 고민하다가 결국 들였어요. 상부장,하부장이 아이보리색으로 변해서 시트지를 붙일 예정이면서도 네이처베이지 색상이 무난해보여서 선택했고 열풍건조 기능이 있고 없고에 따라서 20~30만원 차이가 나기도 했지만 무조건 최신식을 사라는 지인의 말에 선택 완료~ 기존의 서랍장 떼어내는것도 보통일이 아니었는데 기사님 혼자서 어찌나 능숙해서 철거해주시는지 전문가의 손길이 느껴졌어요. (철거비 3만원) 칸을 비워내고 식세기 박스를 개봉하고 오픈하고보니 안에 물기가 있다라구요? 배송전 테스트를 거쳤기때문에 물이 뭍어있는것이 당연하거라고 하시네요!!! 0_ 0\' 테스트에도 2주 지나서 개봉하면 그땐 물기가 사라져있다고하셨는데 저희집껀 테스트를 거친지 며칠 지나지않은거 같았어요. ▶️모드 종류 자동모드 1시간모드 (열풍은 선택) 일반모드 (열풍은 선택) 강력모드 조용모드 건조단독모드 다운로드모드 그외 스팀, 헹굼, 살균, 열풍, 예약, 원격 모드가 있는데 헹굼, 열풍은 횟수나 시간을 추가 선택할 수가 있었어요. 제일 처음으로 1시간 모드로 하고 열풍 40분 모드로 돌려봤는데 물기가 꽤 있더라구요. 다음번엔 자동모드로 해보니 물기가 많이 줄긴했는데 컵 뒷면의 옴폭한 부분에는 물이 남아있는 정도였어요. 아직 식세기와 친해지려고 하는 단계라서 '무진장 좋다 이거..!' 정도는 아니지만...  적응하면 분명히 장점이있는 이모님이 맞아요.  저는 아직 접시,그릇 꽂는 노하우가 부족해서 요령 적응기간이예요ㅋ 간단한거 같으면서도 작동시에 덜컹거릴까봐 대충 못넣겠고 그러네요;;; ✅️ 지역에 따라서 소금을 사용하는거지 무조건 처음부터 소금 사용은 안해도 된다고 하셨고 린스는 꼭 사용하라고 하셨어요. 세제는 클래식탭으로 샀고 린스를 사용하기로 했어요.  ✴️ 1시간 코스로 간단히 돌렸을때 bE오류가 떠서 찾아보니 거품이 과하게 낀 헹굼불량 오류였어요. 헹굼 횟수를 적게 선택했던건지 당황스러웠는데 어쨋든 방법이라고 나온 자가 처리 방법은 우유 한사발을 올려두고 작동시키면 거품이 사라진다고 하여 그대로 실행했더니 그 후로 다시 정상 작동되네요. 아직 적응기간인데 친해지기 어렵네요.....

Comments (English): This is my first dishwasher purchase. I hesitated because I didn't have the confidence to empty the drawers, but I hesitated until the day of installation, and finally bought it. The upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I was planning to put up a sheet, and the nature beige color looked good, so I chose it. The price difference between the hot air dryer and the dryer function was 200,000-300,000 won, but a friend insisted on buying the latest model, so I made my choice. Removing the existing drawers was no easy task, but the technician was so skilled that he did it all by himself. (Removal fee: 30,000 won) After emptying the drawers and opening the dishwasher box, I found that there was moisture inside. They said it was normal for the water to be there because it had been tested before delivery! 0_ 0\" In the test, you said that the moisture would be gone after 2 weeks of opening it, but mine seemed to have been tested only a few days ago. Mode types: automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air is optional), normal mode (hot air is optional), powerful mode, quiet mode, drying mode only, download mode. In addition, there are steam, rinse, sterilization, hot air, reservation, and remote modes. You can select the number of times or time for rinse and hot air. I tried the 1-hour mode for the first time and ran it on the hot air mode for 40 minutes, but there was quite a bit of moisture. The next time I tried the automatic mode, the moisture was reduced a lot, but there was still water in the dent at the back of the cup. I'm still in the process of getting used to the dishwasher, so it's not like 'This is really good. '. But my aunt is right, once you get used to it, there are definitely advantages. It seems simple, but I can't put them in roughly because I'm afraid it'll rattle when I use it;;; Salt is used depending on the region, but it's not necessarily salt from the beginning. They said I didn't have to do it and that I had to use conditioner. I bought a classic tab detergent and decided to use conditioner. When I briefly ran it for an hour, a bE error popped up, so I looked it up and found out it was a rinse failure error due to excessive foam. I was confused because I had selected a low number of rinses, but anyway, the self-treatment method that came up was to put a bowl of milk on it and run it, which said that the foam would disappear, so I did that and it started working normally again. I'm still in the adjustment period, so it's hard to get used to it.

Comments (English): This is my first dishwasher purchase. I hesitated because I didn't have the confidence to empty the drawers, but I hesitated until the day of installation, and finally bought it. Removing the existing drawers was no easy task, but the technician was so skilled that he did it all by himself. Sentence (English): They said it was normal for the water to be there because it had been tested before delivery!
Comments (English): This is my first dishwasher purchase. I hesitated because I didn't have the confidence to empty the drawers, but I hesitated until the day of installation, and finally bought it. The upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I was planning to put up a sheet, and the nature beige color looked good, so I chose it. The price difference between the hot air dryer and the dryer function was 200,000-300,000 won, but a friend insisted on buying the latest model, so I made my choice. Removing the existing drawers was no easy task, but the technician was so skilled that he did it all by himself. (Removal fee: 30,000 won) After emptying the drawers and opening the dishwasher box, I found that there was moisture inside. They said it was normal for the water to be there because it had been tested before delivery! 0_ 0\" In the test, you said that the moisture would be gone after 2 weeks of opening it, but mine seemed to have been tested only a few days ago. Mode types: automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air is optional), normal mode (hot air is optional), powerful mode, quiet mode, drying mode only, download mode. In addition, there are steam, rinse, sterilization, hot air, reservation, and remote modes. You can select the number of times or time for rinse and hot air. I tried the 1-hour mode for the first time and ran it on the hot air mode for 40 minutes, but there was quite a bit of moisture. The next time I tried the automatic mode, the moisture was reduced a lot, but there was still water in the dent at the back of the cup. I'm still in the process of getting used to the dishwasher, so it's not like 'This is really good. '. But my aunt is right, once you get used to it, there are definitely advantages. I'm still lacking the know-how to put in plates and bowls, so I'm still in the adjustment period. It seems simple, but I can't put them in roughly because I'm afraid it'll rattle when I use it;;; Salt is used depending on the region, but it's not necessarily salt from the beginning. They said I didn't have to do it and that I had to use conditioner. I bought a classic tab detergent and decided to use conditioner. When I briefly ran it for an hour, a bE error popped up, so I looked it up and found out it was a rinse failure error due to excessive foam. I was confused because I had selected a low number of rinses, but anyway, the self-treatment method that came up was to put a bowl of milk on it and run it, which said that the foam would disappear, so I did that and it started working normally again. I'm still in the adjustment period, so it's hard to get used to it.

Sentence (English): In addition, there are steam, rinse, sterilization, hot air, reservation, and remote modes.
Comments (English): This is my first dishwasher purchase. I hesitated because I didn't have the confidence to empty the drawers, but I hesitated until the day of installation, and finally bought it. The upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I was planning to put up a sheet, and the nature beige color looked good, so I chose it. The price difference between the hot air dryer and the dryer function was 200,000-300,000 won, but a friend insisted on buying the latest model, so I made my choice. Removing the existing drawers was no easy task, but the technician was so skilled that he did it all by himself. (Removal fee: 30,000 won) After emptying the drawers and opening the dishwasher box, I found that there was moisture inside. They said it was normal for the water to be there because it had been tested before delivery! 0_ 0\" In the test, you said that the moisture would be gone after 2 weeks of opening it, but mine seemed to have been tested only a few days ago. Mode types: automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air is optional), normal mode (hot air is optional), powerful mode, quiet mode, drying mode only, download mode. In addition, there are steam, rinse, sterilization, hot air, reservation, and remote modes. You can select the number of times or time for rinse and hot air. I tried the 1-hour mode for the first time and ran it on the hot air mode for 40 minutes, but there was quite a bit of moisture. The next time I tried the automatic mode, the moisture was reduced a lot, but there was still water in the dent at the back of the cup. I'm still in the process of getting used to the dishwasher, so it's not like 'This is really good. '. But my aunt is right, once you get used to it, there are definitely advantages. I'm still lacking the know-how to put in plates and bowls, so I'm still in the adjustment period. It seems simple, but I can't put them in roughly because I'm afraid it'll rattle when I use it;;; Salt is used depending on the region, but it's not necessarily salt from the beginning. They said I didn't have to do it and that I had to use conditioner. I bought a classic tab detergent and decided to use conditioner. When I briefly ran it for an hour, a bE error popped up, so I looked it up and found out it was a rinse failure error due to excessive foam. I was confused because I had selected a low number of rinses, but anyway, the self-treatment method that came up was to put a bowl of milk on it and run it, which said that the foam would disappear, so I did that and it started working normally again. I'm still in the adjustment period, so it's hard to get used to it.

Comments (English): This is my first dishwasher purchase. I hesitated because I didn't have the confidence to empty the drawers, but I hesitated until the day of installation, and finally bought it. The upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I was planning to put up a sheet, and the nature beige color looked good, so I chose it. The price difference between the hot air dryer and the dryer function was 200,000-300,000 won, but a friend insisted on buying the latest model, so I made my choice. Removing the existing drawers was no easy task, but the technician was so skilled that he did it all by himself. (Removal fee: 30,000 won) After emptying the drawers and opening the dishwasher box, I found that there was moisture inside. They said it was normal for the water to be there because it had been tested before delivery! 0_ 0\" In the test, you said that the moisture would be gone after 2 weeks of opening it, but mine seemed to have been tested only a few days ago. Mode types: automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air is optional), normal mode (hot air is optional), powerful mode, quiet mode, drying mode only, download mode. In addition, there are steam, rinse, sterilization, hot air, reservation, and remote modes. You can select the number of times or time for rinse and hot air. I tried the 1-hour mode for the first time and ran it on the hot air mode for 40 minutes, but there was quite a bit of moisture. The next time I tried the automatic mode, the moisture was reduced a lot, but there was still water in the dent at the back of the cup. I'm still in the process of getting used to the dishwasher, so it's not like 'This is really good. '. But my aunt is right, once you get used to it, there are definitely advantages. I'm still lacking the know-how to put in plates and bowls, so I'm still in the adjustment period. It seems simple, but I can't put them in roughly because I'm afraid it'll rattle when I use it;;; Salt is used depending on the region, but it's not necessarily salt from the beginning. They said I didn't have to do it and that I had to use conditioner. I bought a classic tab detergent and decided to use conditioner. When I briefly ran it for an hour, a bE error popped up, so I looked it up and found out it was a rinse failure error due to excessive foam. I was confused because I had selected a low number of rinses, but anyway, the self-treatment method that came up was to put a bowl of milk on it and run it, which said that the foam would disappear, so I did that and it started working normally again. I'm still in the adjustment period, so it's hard to get used to it.

Comments (English): This is my first dishwasher purchase. I hesitated because I didn't have the confidence to empty the drawers, but I hesitated until the day of installation, and finally bought it. Removing the existing drawers was no easy task, but the technician was so skilled that he did it all by himself. (Removal fee: 30,000 won) After emptying the drawers and opening the dishwasher box, I found that there was moisture inside. Sentence (English): This dishwasher is so quiet, I couldn't tell that it was running at first.
Comments (English): [ Very quiet dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is so quiet, I couldn't tell that it was running at first. I had to open the door to see that the water was running. The cycles dont take as long as previous dishwashers that I've had. A decent cycle takes about 2.5 hours with high heat drying versus 4.5 hours in my previous dishwasher. I love the auto function because it can tell the weight of dishes that are loaded and uses the amount of water needed which saves water. The third rack is amazing. Just a heads up, there is an app you have to install in order to change the functions of the dishwasher like to change the cycle to pot and pans or high heat dry. But the app has a lot of helpful videos that you can watch as well as the manual that included part #s if anything needs replacing. It also notifies you when the dishwasher has completed its cycle and you can remove the dishes. The only con so far is that even with the high heat dry, the plastic dishes still are a little wet. All in all, I say it was a great purchase.

Comments (English): [ Mediocre at best ] || ---------------- || So far, this dishwasher appears to be only slightly better than the 40-year-old Whirlpool I replaced. Even when the soiled surfaces are angled toward the water spray, my pots still have a greasy crusty residue--how is it possible that so little of the original residue was removed? Additionally it takes 3 hours for a full "regular" cycle to complete. 3 hours! The "quick" cycle requires two full hours! How is that saving energy? Of course there is an "extended soak" cycle that is available, but evidently that requires a special type of pre-wash detergent, and not all of my dishes require that. How is this making my life easier or saving me anytime if I still have to scrub all of my dishes before I put them in the dishwasher? And it's not like I'm leaving a lot of food on the dishes--I've already wiped them off into the garbage. And it is incredibly difficult to find any sort of instructions online for using the dishwasher. When the dishwasher was installed all that was provided was a quick start guide. There was a QR code for additional online items, but after clicking on five or six links and entering the model number twice, I still was only given search results of several general articles to read about Whirlpool dishwashers. Why doesn't entering the model number take me directly to the user guide for my dishwasher? I've spent an hour now trying to find user information on how to adjust the tines on the middle rack. At this point I would have saved an enormous amount of time, effort, and frustration by just washing the dishes by hand.

The latest trick is that the detergent pod doesn't dissolve all the way, and it either gets stuck in the spot for it or in the bottom of the dishwasher. I'm ready to go Office Space on this thing so I can get a new one.

We decided to purchase another KitchenAid dishwasher when our old one that was 12 years old finally gave up. There are some great features on the new machine but there are a couple of significant changes in the materials they used in the new machine compared to the old which don't work because they are now made of plastic rather than metal utilized on the old machine.First the postives: 1) I love how quiet the new dishwasher is. The 39 dBA is practically silent which is important with an open kitchen/family room. We hear the occasional swish of water but it is much quieter than our old version partly due to improved insulation. You could see the increase in insulation and sound deadening materials during installation. 2) I also really like the redesigned utensil holder. The small holes that allow the utensils to be kept apart are a well designed upgrade to the new machine. I do wish they had made all the holes the same size as it is a constant game of “will it fit” since some holes are large and some are smaller. It would cause a lot less frustration when loading the utensils if they were all the same slze.3) We had high hopes for the third rack. It is a fantastic additon to be able to wash lids and other FLAT items. In all honesty, with the 3rd rack we are still learning what items make it useful. The clearance is very low and even a large serving spoon or BBQ tongs don't fit well due to the low clearance and the curious multi level design of the rack. The rack seems to be designed with nubs for additional silverwear but I would rather have had space for serving utensils, long BBQ tongs and the like.Now for the negatives:1) On the old machine the adjustable legs for levelling the machine were metal and screwed into metal. They were strong and were up to the task and couldn't be damaged while levelling and raising the machine. On the new machine the mechanism for raising/ lowering and levelling the machine uses PLASTIC parts. The plastic parts support the entire weight of the dishwasher and take significant strain when levelling the machine. The plastic threads on the plastic screws were not strong enough to support the forces applied while levelling the machine and SHEARED OFF the plastic threads, thereby leaving the adjustable legs no longer adjustable, and the mechanism to level the dishwasher no longer functional. I was forced to use shims to level the machine. I'm really disappointed that such an important part has been replaced by cheap plastic.2) Similarly, the kick plate also incorporates plastic (previously metal on the old machine) and the thick metal screws that hold the kick plate in place are screwed into plastic. This plastic is not up to the task and is too soft and after removing the kickplate once or twice the screwholes are now unable to secure the kickplate and the screws just fall out. This is despite the fact that I hand tightened these screws with a screwdriver and was exceptionally gentle and cautious as I knew it was screwed into plastic. The attempt by the manufacturer to save money by replacing important parts with plastic has resulted in my dissatisfaction with these key parts of the dishwasher and tainted my overall impression of my new KitchenAid dishwasher. I will be very cautious before I purchase a third KitchenAid dishwasher after being a loyal and satisfied customer all these years.

Sentence (English): (This review was collected as part of a promotion.)
Comments (English): [ Very clean - horrible software and instructions ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) I worked in software design and implementation for many years before my retirement. I have set up Smart Homes and have pretty well everything you could have that is computer based. I bought this Bosch dishwasher and found the user interface on the phone cluttered and confusing and even the manual controls to be a disaster to work with until you go meticulously through all the manuals. I also have a combination Bosch microwave oven which I love but also find less than easy to use. User interface should be the primary goal. If you cannot use the machine it doesn't really matter whether it cleans well or not. A complete overhaul of the GUI on the way the software presents is needed urgently. When I used the dishwasher for the first time it stopped part way through the cycle in the middle of the night. There were no notifications as to why this happened and no logs in the otherwise extremely detailed (overdetailed? ) app. If I had done this design and implementation I would have expected to lose my job! The time remaining on the display is also confusing - it did not finish when it said and I think it was just a "current step" timer as it the went on to a long dry time. More waiting. I guess I will have to learn and conform to the machine's requirements as it does not seem to care about my needs!

Sentence (English): We decided to purchase another KitchenAid dishwasher when our old one that was 12 years old finally gave up.
Comments (English): [ Good D/W but new plastic parts not up to the task! ] || ---------------- || We decided to purchase another KitchenAid dishwasher when our old one that was 12 years old finally gave up. There are some great features on the new machine but there are a couple of significant changes in the materials they used in the new machine compared to the old which don't work because they are now made of plastic rather than metal utilized on the old machine.First the postives: 1) I love how quiet the new dishwasher is. The 39 dBA is practically silent which is important with an open kitchen/family room. We hear the occasional swish of water but it is much quieter than our old version partly due to improved insulation. You could see the increase in insulation and sound deadening materials during installation. 2) I also really like the redesigned utensil holder. The small holes that allow the utensils to be kept apart are a well designed upgrade to the new machine. I do wish they had made all the holes the same size as it is a constant game of "will it fit" since some holes are large and some are smaller. It would cause a lot less frustration when loading the utensils if they were all the same slze.3) We had high hopes for the third rack. It is a fantastic additon to be able to wash lids and other FLAT items. In all honesty, with the 3rd rack we are still learning what items make it useful. The clearance is very low and even a large serving spoon or BBQ tongs don't fit well due to the low clearance and the curious multi level design of the rack. The rack seems to be designed with nubs for additional silverwear but I would rather have had space for serving utensils, long BBQ tongs and the like.Now for the negatives:1) On the old machine the adjustable legs for levelling the machine were metal and screwed into metal. They were strong and were up to the task and couldn't be damaged while levelling and raising the machine. On the new machine the mechanism for raising/ lowering and levelling the machine uses PLASTIC parts. The plastic parts support the entire weight of the dishwasher and take significant strain when levelling the machine. Sentence (English): This is my first dishwasher purchase.
Comments (English): This is my first dishwasher purchase. I hesitated because I didn't have the confidence to empty the drawers, but I was still worried until the day of installation, and finally bought it. The upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I was planning to put sheeting on them, and I chose the nature beige color because it looked safe. There was a 200,000 to 300,000 won difference in price depending on whether it had a hot air drying function or not, but I made my choice after a friend insisted on buying the latest model. Even removing the existing drawers was no easy task, but the technician was so skilled that he could do it all by himself. (Demolition fee: 30,000 won) After emptying the drawers and opening the dishwasher box, I found that there was moisture inside. They said that it was normal for there to be water because it was tested before delivery! 0_ 0"In the test, you said that if you open it after 2 weeks, the moisture will be gone, but in my case, it seemed like it had only been a few days since the test. Mode type: Automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air is optional), Normal mode (hot air is optional), Powerful mode, Quiet mode, Drying only mode, Download mode. In addition, there are steam, rinse, sterilization, hot air, reservation, and remote modes. You can select additional times or times for rinse and hot air. I tried the 1-hour mode for the first time and ran it on the 40-minute hot air mode, but there was quite a bit of moisture. The next time I tried the automatic mode, the moisture was reduced a lot, but there was still water in the dent at the back of the cup. I'm still in the process of getting used to the dishwasher, so it's not like 'This is so great. '. But, my aunt is right, once you get used to it, there are definitely advantages. I still lack the know-how to put in plates and bowls, so I'm still in the adjustment period. It seems simple, but I can't put them in roughly because I'm afraid it'll rattle when I use it;;; Salt is used depending on the region, so I definitely put salt from the beginning. They said I didn't have to use it, but I had to use conditioner. I bought a classic tab detergent and decided to use conditioner. When I simply ran it for an hour, a bE error popped up, so I looked it up and found out it was a rinse failure error due to excessive foam. I was confused because I chose too few rinses, but anyway, the self-treatment method that came up was to put a bowl of milk on it and run it, so the foam would disappear, so I did that and it started working normally again after that. I'm still in the adjustment period, so it's hard to get used to it.
Comments (Original): 식세기 첫구매.그동안 서랍장을 비울 자신이 없어서 망설였는데 설치당일까지도 고민하다가 결국 들였어요.상부장,하부장이 아이보리색으로 변해서 시트지를 붙일 예정이면서도 네이처베이지 색상이 무난해보여서 선택했고 열풍건조 기능이 있고 없고에 따라서 20~30만원 차이가 나기도 했지만 무조건 최신식을 사라는 지인의 말에 선택 완료~기존의 서랍장 떼어내는것도 보통일이 아니었는데 기사님 혼자서 어찌나 능숙해서 철거해주시는지 전문가의 손길이 느껴졌어요. (철거비 3만원)칸을 비워내고 식세기 박스를 개봉하고 오픈하고보니 안에 물기가 있다라구요?배송전 테스트를 거쳤기때문에 물이 뭍어있는것이 당연하거라고 하시네요!!! 0_ 0'테스트에도 2주 지나서 개봉하면 그땐 물기가 사라져있다고하셨는데 저희집껀 테스트를 거친지 며칠 지나지않은거 같았어요. ▶️모드 종류자동모드1시간모드 (열풍은 선택)일반모드 (열풍은 선택)강력모드조용모드건조단독모드다운로드모드 그외 스팀, 헹굼, 살균, 열풍, 예약, 원격 모드가 있는데 헹굼, 열풍은 횟수나 시간을 추가 선택할 수가 있었어요. 제일 처음으로 1시간 모드로 하고 열풍 40분 모드로 돌려봤는데 물기가 꽤 있더라구요.다음번엔 자동모드로 해보니 물기가 많이 줄긴했는데 컵 뒷면의 옴폭한 부분에는 물이 남아있는 정도였어요. 아직 식세기와 친해지려고 하는 단계라서 '무진장 좋다 이거..!' 정도는 아니지만... 적응하면 분명히 장점이있는 이모님이 맞아요. 저는 아직 접시,그릇 꽂는 노하우가 부족해서 요령 적응기간이예요ㅋ간단한거 같으면서도 작동시에 덜컹거릴까봐 대충 못넣겠고 그러네요;;; ✅️ 지역에 따라서 소금을 사용하는거지 무조건 처음부터 소금 사용은 안해도 된다고 하셨고 린스는 꼭 사용하라고 하셨어요.세제는 클래식탭으로 샀고 린스를 사용하기로 했어요.✴️ 1시간 코스로 간단히 돌렸을때 bE오류가 떠서 찾아보니 거품이 과하게 낀 헹굼불량 오류였어요.헹굼 횟수를 적게 선택했던건지 당황스러웠는데 어쨋든 방법이라고 나온 자가 처리 방법은 우유 한사발을 올려두고 작동시키면 거품이 사라진다고 하여 그대로 실행했더니 그 후로 다시 정상 작동되네요.아직 적응기간인데 친해지기 어렵네요.....

Comments (English): This is my first dishwasher purchase. The upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I was planning to put sheeting on them, and I chose the nature beige color because it looked safe. There was a 200,000 to 300,000 won difference in price depending on whether it had a hot air drying function or not, but I made my choice after a friend insisted on buying the latest model. Even removing the existing drawers was no easy task, but the technician was so skilled that he could do it all by himself. (Demolition fee: 30,000 won) After emptying the drawers and opening the dishwasher box, I found that there was moisture inside. Comments (English): This is my first dishwasher purchase. Even removing the existing drawers was no easy task, but the technician was so skilled that he could do it all by himself. Sentence (English): You can select additional times or times for rinse and hot air.
Comments (English): This is my first dishwasher purchase. I hesitated because I didn't have the confidence to empty the drawers, but I was still worried until the day of installation, and finally bought it. The upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I was planning to put sheeting on them, and I chose the nature beige color because it looked safe. There was a 200,000 to 300,000 won difference in price depending on whether it had a hot air drying function or not, but I made my choice after a friend insisted on buying the latest model. Even removing the existing drawers was no easy task, but the technician was so skilled that he could do it all by himself. (Demolition fee: 30,000 won) After emptying the drawers and opening the dishwasher box, I found that there was moisture inside. I'm still in the adjustment period, so it's hard to get used to it.

Sentence (English): I'm still in the process of getting used to the dishwasher, so it's not like 'This is so great. '.
Comments (English): This is my first dishwasher purchase. I hesitated because I didn't have the confidence to empty the drawers, but I was still worried until the day of installation, and finally bought it. The upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I was planning to put sheeting on them, and I chose the nature beige color because it looked safe. There was a 200,000 to 300,000 won difference in price depending on whether it had a hot air drying function or not, but I made my choice after a friend insisted on buying the latest model. Even removing the existing drawers was no easy task, but the technician was so skilled that he could do it all by himself. (Demolition fee: 30,000 won) After emptying the drawers and opening the dishwasher box, I found that there was moisture inside. They said that it was normal for there to be water because it was tested before delivery! 0_ 0"In the test, you said that if you open it after 2 weeks, the moisture will be gone, but in my case, it seemed like it had only been a few days since the test. Mode type: Automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air is optional), Normal mode (hot air is optional), Powerful mode, Quiet mode, Drying only mode, Download mode. In addition, there are steam, rinse, sterilization, hot air, reservation, and remote modes. You can select additional times or times for rinse and hot air. I tried the 1-hour mode for the first time and ran it on the 40-minute hot air mode, but there was quite a bit of moisture. The next time I tried the automatic mode, the moisture was reduced a lot, but there was still water in the dent at the back of the cup. I'm still in the process of getting used to the dishwasher, so it's not like 'This is so great. '. But, my aunt is right, once you get used to it, there are definitely advantages. I still lack the know-how to put in plates and bowls, so I'm still in the adjustment period. It seems simple, but I can't put them in roughly because I'm afraid it'll rattle when I use it;;; Salt is used depending on the region, so I definitely put salt from the beginning. They said I didn't have to use it, but I had to use conditioner. I bought a classic tab detergent and decided to use conditioner. When I simply ran it for an hour, a bE error popped up, so I looked it up and found out it was a rinse failure error due to excessive foam. I was confused because I chose too few rinses, but anyway, the self-treatment method that came up was to put a bowl of milk on it and run it, so the foam would disappear, so I did that and it started working normally again after that. I'm still in the adjustment period, so it's hard to get used to it.

Comments (English): This is my first dishwasher purchase. Sentence (English): I bought a classic tab detergent and decided to use conditioner.
Comments (English): This is my first dishwasher purchase. I hesitated because I didn't have the confidence to empty the drawers, but I was still worried until the day of installation, and finally bought it. The upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I was planning to put sheeting on them, and I chose the nature beige color because it looked safe. There was a 200,000 to 300,000 won difference in price depending on whether it had a hot air drying function or not, but I made my choice after a friend insisted on buying the latest model. Even removing the existing drawers was no easy task, but the technician was so skilled that he could do it all by himself. (Demolition fee: 30,000 won) After emptying the drawers and opening the dishwasher box, I found that there was moisture inside. They said that it was normal for there to be water because it was tested before delivery! 0_ 0"In the test, you said that if you open it after 2 weeks, the moisture will be gone, but in my case, it seemed like it had only been a few days since the test. Mode type: Automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air is optional), Normal mode (hot air is optional), Powerful mode, Quiet mode, Drying only mode, Download mode. In addition, there are steam, rinse, sterilization, hot air, reservation, and remote modes. You can select additional times or times for rinse and hot air. I tried the 1-hour mode for the first time and ran it on the 40-minute hot air mode, but there was quite a bit of moisture. The next time I tried the automatic mode, the moisture was reduced a lot, but there was still water in the dent at the back of the cup. I'm still in the process of getting used to the dishwasher, so it's not like 'This is so great. '. But, my aunt is right, once you get used to it, there are definitely advantages. I still lack the know-how to put in plates and bowls, so I'm still in the adjustment period. It seems simple, but I can't put them in roughly because I'm afraid it'll rattle when I use it;;; Salt is used depending on the region, so I definitely put salt from the beginning. They said I didn't have to use it, but I had to use conditioner. I bought a classic tab detergent and decided to use conditioner. When I simply ran it for an hour, a bE error popped up, so I looked it up and found out it was a rinse failure error due to excessive foam. I was confused because I chose too few rinses, but anyway, the self-treatment method that came up was to put a bowl of milk on it and run it, so the foam would disappear, so I did that and it started working normally again after that. I'm still in the adjustment period, so it's hard to get used to it.

Comments (English): This is my first dishwasher purchase. I hesitated because I didn't have the confidence to empty the drawers, but I was still worried until the day of installation, and finally bought it. The upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I was planning to put sheeting on them, and I chose the nature beige color because it looked safe. There was a 200,000 to 300,000 won difference in price depending on whether it had a hot air drying function or not, but I made my choice after a friend insisted on buying the latest model. Even removing the existing drawers was no easy task, but the technician was so skilled that he could do it all by himself. (Demolition fee: 30,000 won) After emptying the drawers and opening the dishwasher box, I found that there was moisture inside. Mode type: Automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air is optional), Normal mode (hot air is optional), Powerful mode, Quiet mode, Drying only mode, Download mode. In addition, there are steam, rinse, sterilization, hot air, reservation, and remote modes. You can select additional times or times for rinse and hot air. I tried the 1-hour mode for the first time and ran it on the 40-minute hot air mode, but there was quite a bit of moisture. The next time I tried the automatic mode, the moisture was reduced a lot, but there was still water in the dent at the back of the cup. It seems simple, but I can't put them in roughly because I'm afraid it'll rattle when I use it;;; Salt is used depending on the region, so I definitely put salt from the beginning. They said I didn't have to use it, but I had to use conditioner. I bought a classic tab detergent and decided to use conditioner. When I simply ran it for an hour, a bE error popped up, so I looked it up and found out it was a rinse failure error due to excessive foam. I was confused because I chose too few rinses, but anyway, the self-treatment method that came up was to put a bowl of milk on it and run it, so the foam would disappear, so I did that and it started working normally again after that. I'm still in the adjustment period, so it's hard to get used to it.

Sentence (English): This is my first time buying a dishwasher.
Comments (English): This is my first time buying a dishwasher. I had been hesitating because I wasn't confident about emptying out my drawers, and I debated it right up until the day of installation, but I finally decided to get one. My upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I planned to apply adhesive film to them; I chose the Nature Beige color because it looked like a safe choice. There was a price difference of 200,000 to 300,000 won depending on whether or not it had a hot air drying function, but I made my decision based on a friend's advice to buy the latest model no matter what. Removing the old drawers was no easy task, but the technician removed them all by himself with such skill that I could really feel the touch of a professional. (Removal fee: 30,000 won). After emptying out the compartments and opening the dishwasher box, I noticed there was moisture inside? He explained that it is only natural for there to be water because it underwent testing before delivery! You mentioned that if you open it after two weeks of testing, the moisture would be gone, but it seemed like only a few days had passed since the test. Mode types: Automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air optional), Normal mode (hot air optional), Powerful mode, Quiet mode, Dry-only mode, Download mode. In addition, there are Steam, Rinse, Sterilize, Hot Air, Schedule, and Remote modes; for Rinse and Hot Air, you could select additional cycles or times. I tried the 1-hour mode first and ran it on the 40-minute hot air setting, and there was quite a bit of moisture. The next time, I tried Automatic mode, and while the moisture decreased significantly, some water still remained in the indented areas on the back of the cups. Since I am still in the stage of getting familiar with the dishwasher, it’s not quite at the "this is amazing" level yet. However, once you get used to it, it definitely has its advantages. I still lack the know-how to load plates and dishes, so I am in the learning phase. It seems simple, but I can't just throw them in haphazardly because I'm worried they might rattle during operation. Depending on the region... They told me that while salt is an option, I don't necessarily have to use it from the start, but I absolutely must use rinse aid. I bought the Classic Tab detergent and decided to use the rinse aid. When I ran a quick 1-hour cycle, a 'bE' error popped up. After looking it up, I found it was a rinsing failure error caused by excessive foam. I was flustered, wondering if I had selected too few rinse cycles, but the suggested DIY fix involved placing a bowl of milk on the machine while it ran to make the foam disappear. I followed those instructions, and it has been working normally ever since. I'm still in the adjustment period, and it's hard to get used to this machine.

Sentence (English): I had been hesitating because I wasn't confident about emptying out my drawers, and I debated it right up until the day of installation, but I finally decided to get one.
Comments (English): This is my first time buying a dishwasher. I had been hesitating because I wasn't confident about emptying out my drawers, and I debated it right up until the day of installation, but I finally decided to get one. My upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I planned to apply adhesive film to them; I chose the Nature Beige color because it looked like a safe choice. There was a price difference of 200,000 to 300,000 won depending on whether or not it had a hot air drying function, but I made my decision based on a friend's advice to buy the latest model no matter what. Removing the old drawers was no easy task, but the technician removed them all by himself with such skill that I could really feel the touch of a professional. (Removal fee: 30,000 won). After emptying out the compartments and opening the dishwasher box, I noticed there was moisture inside? He explained that it is only natural for there to be water because it underwent testing before delivery! You mentioned that if you open it after two weeks of testing, the moisture would be gone, but it seemed like only a few days had passed since the test. Mode types: Automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air optional), Normal mode (hot air optional), Powerful mode, Quiet mode, Dry-only mode, Download mode. In addition, there are Steam, Rinse, Sterilize, Hot Air, Schedule, and Remote modes; for Rinse and Hot Air, you could select additional cycles or times. I tried the 1-hour mode first and ran it on the 40-minute hot air setting, and there was quite a bit of moisture. The next time, I tried Automatic mode, and while the moisture decreased significantly, some water still remained in the indented areas on the back of the cups. Since I am still in the stage of getting familiar with the dishwasher, it’s not quite at the "this is amazing" level yet. However, once you get used to it, it definitely has its advantages. I still lack the know-how to load plates and dishes, so I am in the learning phase. It seems simple, but I can't just throw them in haphazardly because I'm worried they might rattle during operation. Depending on the region... They told me that while salt is an option, I don't necessarily have to use it from the start, but I absolutely must use rinse aid. I bought the Classic Tab detergent and decided to use the rinse aid. When I ran a quick 1-hour cycle, a 'bE' error popped up. After looking it up, I found it was a rinsing failure error caused by excessive foam. I was flustered, wondering if I had selected too few rinse cycles, but the suggested DIY fix involved placing a bowl of milk on the machine while it ran to make the foam disappear. I followed those instructions, and it has been working normally ever since. I'm still in the adjustment period, and it's hard to get used to this machine.

Comments (English): This is my first time buying a dishwasher. I had been hesitating because I wasn't confident about emptying out my drawers, and I debated it right up until the day of installation, but I finally decided to get one. My upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I planned to apply adhesive film to them; I chose the Nature Beige color because it looked like a safe choice. There was a price difference of 200,000 to 300,000 won depending on whether or not it had a hot air drying function, but I made my decision based on a friend's advice to buy the latest model no matter what. Removing the old drawers was no easy task, but the technician removed them all by himself with such skill that I could really feel the touch of a professional. (Removal fee: 30,000 won). After emptying out the compartments and opening the dishwasher box, I noticed there was moisture inside? He explained that it is only natural for there to be water because it underwent testing before delivery! You mentioned that if you open it after two weeks of testing, the moisture would be gone, but it seemed like only a few days had passed since the test. Mode types: Automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air optional), Normal mode (hot air optional), Powerful mode, Quiet mode, Dry-only mode, Download mode. Since I am still in the stage of getting familiar with the dishwasher, it’s not quite at the "this is amazing" level yet. However, once you get used to it, it definitely has its advantages. Depending on the region... They told me that while salt is an option, I don't necessarily have to use it from the start, but I absolutely must use rinse aid. I bought the Classic Tab detergent and decided to use the rinse aid. When I ran a quick 1-hour cycle, a 'bE' error popped up. Sentence (English): After emptying out the compartments and opening the dishwasher box, I noticed there was moisture inside?
Comments (English): This is my first time buying a dishwasher. I had been hesitating because I wasn't confident about emptying out my drawers, and I debated it right up until the day of installation, but I finally decided to get one. My upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I planned to apply adhesive film to them; I chose the Nature Beige color because it looked like a safe choice. There was a price difference of 200,000 to 300,000 won depending on whether or not it had a hot air drying function, but I made my decision based on a friend's advice to buy the latest model no matter what. Removing the old drawers was no easy task, but the technician removed them all by himself with such skill that I could really feel the touch of a professional. (Removal fee: 30,000 won). After emptying out the compartments and opening the dishwasher box, I noticed there was moisture inside? He explained that it is only natural for there to be water because it underwent testing before delivery! You mentioned that if you open it after two weeks of testing, the moisture would be gone, but it seemed like only a few days had passed since the test. Mode types: Automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air optional), Normal mode (hot air optional), Powerful mode, Quiet mode, Dry-only mode, Download mode. In addition, there are Steam, Rinse, Sterilize, Hot Air, Schedule, and Remote modes; for Rinse and Hot Air, you could select additional cycles or times. I tried the 1-hour mode first and ran it on the 40-minute hot air setting, and there was quite a bit of moisture. The next time, I tried Automatic mode, and while the moisture decreased significantly, some water still remained in the indented areas on the back of the cups. Since I am still in the stage of getting familiar with the dishwasher, it’s not quite at the "this is amazing" level yet. However, once you get used to it, it definitely has its advantages. I still lack the know-how to load plates and dishes, so I am in the learning phase. It seems simple, but I can't just throw them in haphazardly because I'm worried they might rattle during operation. Depending on the region... They told me that while salt is an option, I don't necessarily have to use it from the start, but I absolutely must use rinse aid. I bought the Classic Tab detergent and decided to use the rinse aid. When I ran a quick 1-hour cycle, a 'bE' error popped up. After looking it up, I found it was a rinsing failure error caused by excessive foam. I was flustered, wondering if I had selected too few rinse cycles, but the suggested DIY fix involved placing a bowl of milk on the machine while it ran to make the foam disappear. I followed those instructions, and it has been working normally ever since. I'm still in the adjustment period, and it's hard to get used to this machine.

Sentence (English): Mode types: Automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air optional), Normal mode (hot air optional), Powerful mode, Quiet mode, Dry-only mode, Download mode.
Comments (English): This is my first time buying a dishwasher. I had been hesitating because I wasn't confident about emptying out my drawers, and I debated it right up until the day of installation, but I finally decided to get one. My upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I planned to apply adhesive film to them; I chose the Nature Beige color because it looked like a safe choice. There was a price difference of 200,000 to 300,000 won depending on whether or not it had a hot air drying function, but I made my decision based on a friend's advice to buy the latest model no matter what. Removing the old drawers was no easy task, but the technician removed them all by himself with such skill that I could really feel the touch of a professional. (Removal fee: 30,000 won). After emptying out the compartments and opening the dishwasher box, I noticed there was moisture inside? He explained that it is only natural for there to be water because it underwent testing before delivery! You mentioned that if you open it after two weeks of testing, the moisture would be gone, but it seemed like only a few days had passed since the test. Mode types: Automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air optional), Normal mode (hot air optional), Powerful mode, Quiet mode, Dry-only mode, Download mode. In addition, there are Steam, Rinse, Sterilize, Hot Air, Schedule, and Remote modes; for Rinse and Hot Air, you could select additional cycles or times. I tried the 1-hour mode first and ran it on the 40-minute hot air setting, and there was quite a bit of moisture. The next time, I tried Automatic mode, and while the moisture decreased significantly, some water still remained in the indented areas on the back of the cups. Since I am still in the stage of getting familiar with the dishwasher, it’s not quite at the "this is amazing" level yet. However, once you get used to it, it definitely has its advantages. I still lack the know-how to load plates and dishes, so I am in the learning phase. It seems simple, but I can't just throw them in haphazardly because I'm worried they might rattle during operation. Depending on the region... They told me that while salt is an option, I don't necessarily have to use it from the start, but I absolutely must use rinse aid. After looking it up, I found it was a rinsing failure error caused by excessive foam. I was flustered, wondering if I had selected too few rinse cycles, but the suggested DIY fix involved placing a bowl of milk on the machine while it ran to make the foam disappear. Mode types: Automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air optional), Normal mode (hot air optional), Powerful mode, Quiet mode, Dry-only mode, Download mode. Comments (English): This is my first time buying a dishwasher. I had been hesitating because I wasn't confident about emptying out my drawers, and I debated it right up until the day of installation, but I finally decided to get one. My upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I planned to apply adhesive film to them; I chose the Nature Beige color because it looked like a safe choice. There was a price difference of 200,000 to 300,000 won depending on whether or not it had a hot air drying function, but I made my decision based on a friend's advice to buy the latest model no matter what. Removing the old drawers was no easy task, but the technician removed them all by himself with such skill that I could really feel the touch of a professional. (Removal fee: 30,000 won). After emptying out the compartments and opening the dishwasher box, I noticed there was moisture inside? He explained that it is only natural for there to be water because it underwent testing before delivery! You mentioned that if you open it after two weeks of testing, the moisture would be gone, but it seemed like only a few days had passed since the test. Mode types: Automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air optional), Normal mode (hot air optional), Powerful mode, Quiet mode, Dry-only mode, Download mode. In addition, there are Steam, Rinse, Sterilize, Hot Air, Schedule, and Remote modes; for Rinse and Hot Air, you could select additional cycles or times. I tried the 1-hour mode first and ran it on the 40-minute hot air setting, and there was quite a bit of moisture. The next time, I tried Automatic mode, and while the moisture decreased significantly, some water still remained in the indented areas on the back of the cups. Since I am still in the stage of getting familiar with the dishwasher, it’s not quite at the "this is amazing" level yet. However, once you get used to it, it definitely has its advantages. I still lack the know-how to load plates and dishes, so I am in the learning phase. It seems simple, but I can't just throw them in haphazardly because I'm worried they might rattle during operation. Depending on the region... They told me that while salt is an option, I don't necessarily have to use it from the start, but I absolutely must use rinse aid. I bought the Classic Tab detergent and decided to use the rinse aid. When I ran a quick 1-hour cycle, a 'bE' error popped up. After looking it up, I found it was a rinsing failure error caused by excessive foam. I was flustered, wondering if I had selected too few rinse cycles, but the suggested DIY fix involved placing a bowl of milk on the machine while it ran to make the foam disappear. I followed those instructions, and it has been working normally ever since. I'm still in the adjustment period, and it's hard to get used to this machine.

Comments (English): This is my first time buying a dishwasher. I had been hesitating because I wasn't confident about emptying out my drawers, and I debated it right up until the day of installation, but I finally decided to get one. My upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I planned to apply adhesive film to them; I chose the Nature Beige color because it looked like a safe choice. There was a price difference of 200,000 to 300,000 won depending on whether or not it had a hot air drying function, but I made my decision based on a friend's advice to buy the latest model no matter what. Removing the old drawers was no easy task, but the technician removed them all by himself with such skill that I could really feel the touch of a professional. (Removal fee: 30,000 won). After emptying out the compartments and opening the dishwasher box, I noticed there was moisture inside? He explained that it is only natural for there to be water because it underwent testing before delivery! You mentioned that if you open it after two weeks of testing, the moisture would be gone, but it seemed like only a few days had passed since the test. Mode types: Automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air optional), Normal mode (hot air optional), Powerful mode, Quiet mode, Dry-only mode, Download mode. My upper and lower cabinets had turned ivory, so I planned to apply adhesive film to them; I chose the Nature Beige color because it looked like a safe choice. There was a price difference of 200,000 to 300,000 won depending on whether or not it had a hot air drying function, but I made my decision based on a friend's advice to buy the latest model no matter what. Removing the old drawers was no easy task, but the technician removed them all by himself with such skill that I could really feel the touch of a professional. (Removal fee: 30,000 won). After emptying out the compartments and opening the dishwasher box, I noticed there was moisture inside? He explained that it is only natural for there to be water because it underwent testing before delivery! You mentioned that if you open it after two weeks of testing, the moisture would be gone, but it seemed like only a few days had passed since the test. Mode types: Automatic mode, 1-hour mode (hot air optional), Normal mode (hot air optional), Powerful mode, Quiet mode, Dry-only mode, Download mode. In addition, there are Steam, Rinse, Sterilize, Hot Air, Schedule, and Remote modes; for Rinse and Hot Air, you could select additional cycles or times. I tried the 1-hour mode first and ran it on the 40-minute hot air setting, and there was quite a bit of moisture. The next time, I tried Automatic mode, and while the moisture decreased significantly, some water still remained in the indented areas on the back of the cups. Since I am still in the stage of getting familiar with the dishwasher, it’s not quite at the "this is amazing" level yet. However, once you get used to it, it definitely has its advantages. I still lack the know-how to load plates and dishes, so I am in the learning phase. It seems simple, but I can't just throw them in haphazardly because I'm worried they might rattle during operation. Depending on the region... They told me that while salt is an option, I don't necessarily have to use it from the start, but I absolutely must use rinse aid. I bought the Classic Tab detergent and decided to use the rinse aid. When I ran a quick 1-hour cycle, a 'bE' error popped up. After looking it up, I found it was a rinsing failure error caused by excessive foam. I was flustered, wondering if I had selected too few rinse cycles, but the suggested DIY fix involved placing a bowl of milk on the machine while it ran to make the foam disappear. I followed those instructions, and it has been working normally ever since. I'm still in the adjustment period, and it's hard to get used to this machine.
