Sentence (English): We are a newlywed couple who cook at home, and we were stressed out every time we did the dishes, so we bought a dishwasher that was simple and easy to use with no drilling or installation.
Comments (English): [ #Essential for 1~2 person households #Free from washing dishes #No need to worry about grease! ] || ---------------- || We are a newlywed couple who cook at home, and we were stressed out every time we did the dishes, so we bought a dishwasher that was simple and easy to use with no drilling or installation. Cleaning power: This was the part that worried me the most when choosing a dishwasher. There were things like the scum stuck on after grilling fish in the air fryer or oven, the grease left over after eating meat, and dishes with various sauces like ketchup on them, etc. I didn't have high expectations and thought I'd wash it again if it didn't come off, but I was so surprised to see that it really came off cleanly, so now I trust it and just use it. I don't check it separately except when I take the dishes out. *However, if there are scum stuck on or if there is a lot of contamination, I run it on the strong cycle. Easy to use: It doesn't have many special functions, so if you just fill it with water and detergent, you're done with the dishes in a few operations! It's really convenient. I love how it automatically manages the dishwasher with 24-hour security. Size: One of the reasons I chose the Minix dishwasher was because I was looking for the perfect size for a two-person household. It's a comfortable size, and there's plenty of storage space for dishes, bowls, etc., so I didn't feel it was lacking. Noise: I turn it on at 9 p.m. every night and go to bed around 10 p.m., so it wasn't too bothersome when I was sleeping with it running in the kitchen. I don't know about those who are sensitive to noise, but I think this level of noise is acceptable. Highly recommended for newlyweds, parents who struggle with dishwashing, and single-person households! Before using it, I worried it wouldn't clean properly and that the detergent was more expensive than I thought. But I heard that the Flush Mini dishwasher detergent was a good fit, and it's affordable and doesn't leave any residue, so I'm using it with pleasure. Now I can cook meat and grill fish without any worries, and I can save time washing dishes and do other things, which is great!

Sentence (English): Review of the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher!
Comments (English): Review of the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher! 1. Purchase Review: I'm a sucker for washing dishes, but I always tell myself I'll just take a quick break after dinner! But I end up putting it off until nighttime. It's okay since there are only a few cups, plates, and chopsticks, but the piles get stressful. So, I finally bought the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher. This is truly a blessing! 2. Design: I love the clean, dark color. My kitchen is white, so I was worried the dark color would stand out, but it doesn't, and the size is comfortable! The fact that it's a direct-flow unit means no plumbing is a plus! No installation required. Just fill the tank with water and connect the drain pipe. Installation was stress-free. Follow the instructions and it's done in no time! 3. Capacity: Since it's designed for 3 people, I was worried it might be too small for a 6-person kitchen, but it was perfect for our family of two! It can fit two soup bowls, two rice bowls, chopsticks, and a cup, and more! If you play Tetris properly, it could even double. The nozzle rotates 360 degrees, ensuring thorough cleaning. (Don't let anything touch the nozzle! Apparently, the sound changes if it does.) At first, I was skeptical that the machine would clean better than I could with a scrub brush, but it's much cleaner than I can handle. 4. Noise & Washing Time: It's quieter than I thought. Of course, it's not completely silent, but it's quiet enough that I can run it at night without any problems. I can even listen to it while watching TV! There are several wash cycles, but I usually use the standard cycle (about 1 hour and 20 minutes). For greasy dishes, choose the intensive cycle, and for a quick rinse, choose the quick cycle. Having a wide range of options allows me to choose the right one for every situation, which is another huge advantage! 5. Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Since I only run it once a day, there was almost no difference in the electricity bill. I always run the water all the way through when I wash dishes, and it actually saves a lot of water! They say it uses only about 1/3 of the water compared to washing by hand. But you have to add 5-6L of water! So, after each run, you have to refill the water right away? 6. Disappointing Points: I don't have any drawbacks with Gwangmyeongchat, but if I had to point out one, it's that because it uses heat to dry, there are times when a few water droplets remain in the plastic container. I leave the door slightly open and let it air dry, so it's not a big deal! 7. Overall: Honestly, since using this, I feel like I've escaped the dishwashing hell, and my stress has almost disappeared. I enjoy cooking home-cooked meals and running the dishwasher every day. After eating, I just do a quick wash, put the dishes in, and press a button. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Sentence (English): So, I finally bought the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher.
Comments (English): Review of the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher! 1. Purchase Review: I'm a sucker for washing dishes, but I always tell myself I'll just take a quick break after dinner! But I end up putting it off until nighttime. It's okay since there are only a few cups, plates, and chopsticks, but the piles get stressful. So, I finally bought the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher. This is truly a blessing! 2. Design: I love the clean, dark color. My kitchen is white, so I was worried the dark color would stand out, but it doesn't, and the size is comfortable! The fact that it's a direct-flow unit means no plumbing is a plus! No installation required. Just fill the tank with water and connect the drain pipe. Installation was stress-free. Follow the instructions and it's done in no time! 3. Capacity: Since it's designed for 3 people, I was worried it might be too small for a 6-person kitchen, but it was perfect for our family of two! It can fit two soup bowls, two rice bowls, chopsticks, and a cup, and more! If you play Tetris properly, it could even double. The nozzle rotates 360 degrees, ensuring thorough cleaning. (Don't let anything touch the nozzle! Apparently, the sound changes if it does.) At first, I was skeptical that the machine would clean better than I could with a scrub brush, but it's much cleaner than I can handle. 4. Noise & Washing Time: It's quieter than I thought. Of course, it's not completely silent, but it's quiet enough that I can run it at night without any problems. I can even listen to it while watching TV! There are several wash cycles, but I usually use the standard cycle (about 1 hour and 20 minutes). For greasy dishes, choose the intensive cycle, and for a quick rinse, choose the quick cycle. Having a wide range of options allows me to choose the right one for every situation, which is another huge advantage! 5. Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Since I only run it once a day, there was almost no difference in the electricity bill. I always run the water all the way through when I wash dishes, and it actually saves a lot of water! They say it uses only about 1/3 of the water compared to washing by hand. But you have to add 5-6L of water! So, after each run, you have to refill the water right away? 6. Disappointing Points: I don't have any drawbacks with Gwangmyeongchat, but if I had to point out one, it's that because it uses heat to dry, there are times when a few water droplets remain in the plastic container. I leave the door slightly open and let it air dry, so it's not a big deal! 7. Overall: Honestly, since using this, I feel like I've escaped the dishwashing hell, and my stress has almost disappeared. I enjoy cooking home-cooked meals and running the dishwasher every day. After eating, I just do a quick wash, put the dishes in, and press a button. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Comments (English): Review of the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher! 1. Purchase Review: I'm a sucker for washing dishes, but I always tell myself I'll just take a quick break after dinner! But I end up putting it off until nighttime. It's okay since there are only a few cups, plates, and chopsticks, but the piles get stressful. So, I finally bought the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher. This is truly a blessing! 2. Design: I love the clean, dark color. My kitchen is white, so I was worried the dark color would stand out, but it doesn't, and the size is comfortable! The fact that it's a direct-flow unit means no plumbing is a plus! No installation required. Just fill the tank with water and connect the drain pipe. Installation was stress-free. Follow the instructions and it's done in no time! 3. Capacity: Since it's designed for 3 people, I was worried it might be too small for a 6-person kitchen, but it was perfect for our family of two! It can fit two soup bowls, two rice bowls, chopsticks, and a cup, and more! If you play Tetris properly, it could even double. The nozzle rotates 360 degrees, ensuring thorough cleaning. (Don't let anything touch the nozzle! Apparently, the sound changes if it does.) At first, I was skeptical that the machine would clean better than I could with a scrub brush, but it's much cleaner than I can handle. 4. Noise & Washing Time: It's quieter than I thought. Of course, it's not completely silent, but it's quiet enough that I can run it at night without any problems. I can even listen to it while watching TV! There are several wash cycles, but I usually use the standard cycle (about 1 hour and 20 minutes). For greasy dishes, choose the intensive cycle, and for a quick rinse, choose the quick cycle. Having a wide range of options allows me to choose the right one for every situation, which is another huge advantage! 5. Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Since I only run it once a day, there was almost no difference in the electricity bill. I always run the water all the way through when I wash dishes, and it actually saves a lot of water! They say it uses only about 1/3 of the water compared to washing by hand. But you have to add 5-6L of water! So, after each run, you have to refill the water right away? 6. Disappointing Points: I don't have any drawbacks with Gwangmyeongchat, but if I had to point out one, it's that because it uses heat to dry, there are times when a few water droplets remain in the plastic container. I leave the door slightly open and let it air dry, so it's not a big deal! 7. Overall: Honestly, since using this, I feel like I've escaped the dishwashing hell, and my stress has almost disappeared. I enjoy cooking home-cooked meals and running the dishwasher every day. After eating, I just do a quick wash, put the dishes in, and press a button. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Comments (English): Review of the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher! 1. Purchase Review: I'm a sucker for washing dishes, but I always tell myself I'll just take a quick break after dinner! But I end up putting it off until nighttime. It's okay since there are only a few cups, plates, and chopsticks, but the piles get stressful. So, I finally bought the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher. This is truly a blessing! 2. Design: I love the clean, dark color. My kitchen is white, so I was worried the dark color would stand out, but it doesn't, and the size is comfortable! The fact that it's a direct-flow unit means no plumbing is a plus! No installation required. Just fill the tank with water and connect the drain pipe. Installation was stress-free. Follow the instructions and it's done in no time! 3. Capacity: Since it's designed for 3 people, I was worried it might be too small for a 6-person kitchen, but it was perfect for our family of two! It can fit two soup bowls, two rice bowls, chopsticks, and a cup, and more! If you play Tetris properly, it could even double. The nozzle rotates 360 degrees, ensuring thorough cleaning. (Don't let anything touch the nozzle! Apparently, the sound changes if it does.) At first, I was skeptical that the machine would clean better than I could with a scrub brush, but it's much cleaner than I can handle. 4. Noise & Washing Time: It's quieter than I thought. Of course, it's not completely silent, but it's quiet enough that I can run it at night without any problems. I can even listen to it while watching TV! There are several wash cycles, but I usually use the standard cycle (about 1 hour and 20 minutes). For greasy dishes, choose the intensive cycle, and for a quick rinse, choose the quick cycle. Having a wide range of options allows me to choose the right one for every situation, which is another huge advantage! 5. Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Since I only run it once a day, there was almost no difference in the electricity bill. I always run the water all the way through when I wash dishes, and it actually saves a lot of water! They say it uses only about 1/3 of the water compared to washing by hand. But you have to add 5-6L of water! So, after each run, you have to refill the water right away? 6. Disappointing Points: I don't have any drawbacks with Gwangmyeongchat, but if I had to point out one, it's that because it uses heat to dry, there are times when a few water droplets remain in the plastic container. I leave the door slightly open and let it air dry, so it's not a big deal! 7. Overall: Honestly, since using this, I feel like I've escaped the dishwashing hell, and my stress has almost disappeared. I enjoy cooking home-cooked meals and running the dishwasher every day. After eating, I just do a quick wash, put the dishes in, and press a button. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Comments (English): Review of the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher! 1. Purchase Review: I'm a sucker for washing dishes, but I always tell myself I'll just take a quick break after dinner! But I end up putting it off until nighttime. It's okay since there are only a few cups, plates, and chopsticks, but the piles get stressful. So, I finally bought the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher. This is truly a blessing! 2. Design: I love the clean, dark color. My kitchen is white, so I was worried the dark color would stand out, but it doesn't, and the size is comfortable! The fact that it's a direct-flow unit means no plumbing is a plus! No installation required. Just fill the tank with water and connect the drain pipe. Installation was stress-free. Follow the instructions and it's done in no time! 3. Capacity: Since it's designed for 3 people, I was worried it might be too small for a 6-person kitchen, but it was perfect for our family of two! It can fit two soup bowls, two rice bowls, chopsticks, and a cup, and more! If you play Tetris properly, it could even double. The nozzle rotates 360 degrees, ensuring thorough cleaning. (Don't let anything touch the nozzle! Apparently, the sound changes if it does.) At first, I was skeptical that the machine would clean better than I could with a scrub brush, but it's much cleaner than I can handle. 4. Noise & Washing Time: It's quieter than I thought. Of course, it's not completely silent, but it's quiet enough that I can run it at night without any problems. I can even listen to it while watching TV! There are several wash cycles, but I usually use the standard cycle (about 1 hour and 20 minutes). For greasy dishes, choose the intensive cycle, and for a quick rinse, choose the quick cycle. Having a wide range of options allows me to choose the right one for every situation, which is another huge advantage! 5. Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Since I only run it once a day, there was almost no difference in the electricity bill. I always run the water all the way through when I wash dishes, and it actually saves a lot of water! They say it uses only about 1/3 of the water compared to washing by hand. But you have to add 5-6L of water! So, after each run, you have to refill the water right away? 6. Disappointing Points: I don't have any drawbacks with Gwangmyeongchat, but if I had to point out one, it's that because it uses heat to dry, there are times when a few water droplets remain in the plastic container. I leave the door slightly open and let it air dry, so it's not a big deal! 7. Overall: Honestly, since using this, I feel like I've escaped the dishwashing hell, and my stress has almost disappeared. I enjoy cooking home-cooked meals and running the dishwasher every day. After eating, I just do a quick wash, put the dishes in, and press a button. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Comments (English): Review of the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher! 1. Purchase Review: I'm a sucker for washing dishes, but I always tell myself I'll just take a quick break after dinner! (Don't let anything touch the nozzle! Apparently, the sound changes if it does.) At first, I was skeptical that the machine would clean better than I could with a scrub brush, but it's much cleaner than I can handle. 4. Noise & Washing Time: It's quieter than I thought. Of course, it's not completely silent, but it's quiet enough that I can run it at night without any problems. I can even listen to it while watching TV! There are several wash cycles, but I usually use the standard cycle (about 1 hour and 20 minutes). For greasy dishes, choose the intensive cycle, and for a quick rinse, choose the quick cycle. Having a wide range of options allows me to choose the right one for every situation, which is another huge advantage! 5. Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Since I only run it once a day, there was almost no difference in the electricity bill. I always run the water all the way through when I wash dishes, and it actually saves a lot of water! They say it uses only about 1/3 of the water compared to washing by hand. But you have to add 5-6L of water! So, after each run, you have to refill the water right away? 6. Disappointing Points: I don't have any drawbacks with Gwangmyeongchat, but if I had to point out one, it's that because it uses heat to dry, there are times when a few water droplets remain in the plastic container. I leave the door slightly open and let it air dry, so it's not a big deal! 7. Overall: Honestly, since using this, I feel like I've escaped the dishwashing hell, and my stress has almost disappeared. I enjoy cooking home-cooked meals and running the dishwasher every day. After eating, I just do a quick wash, put the dishes in, and press a button. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! Highly recommended!

Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Disappointing Points: I don't have any drawbacks with Gwangmyeongchat, but if I had to point out one, it's that because it uses heat to dry, there are times when a few water droplets remain in the plastic container. I enjoy cooking home-cooked meals and running the dishwasher every day. After eating, I just do a quick wash, put the dishes in, and press a button. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Comments (English): Review of the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher! 1. Purchase Review: I'm a sucker for washing dishes, but I always tell myself I'll just take a quick break after dinner! But I end up putting it off until nighttime. It's okay since there are only a few cups, plates, and chopsticks, but the piles get stressful. So, I finally bought the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher. This is truly a blessing! 2. Design: I love the clean, dark color. My kitchen is white, so I was worried the dark color would stand out, but it doesn't, and the size is comfortable! The fact that it's a direct-flow unit means no plumbing is a plus! No installation required. Just fill the tank with water and connect the drain pipe. Installation was stress-free. Follow the instructions and it's done in no time! 3. Capacity: Since it's designed for 3 people, I was worried it might be too small for a 6-person kitchen, but it was perfect for our family of two! It can fit two soup bowls, two rice bowls, chopsticks, and a cup, and more! If you play Tetris properly, it could even double. The nozzle rotates 360 degrees, ensuring thorough cleaning. (Don't let anything touch the nozzle! Apparently, the sound changes if it does.) At first, I was skeptical that the machine would clean better than I could with a scrub brush, but it's much cleaner than I can handle. 4. Noise & Washing Time: It's quieter than I thought. Of course, it's not completely silent, but it's quiet enough that I can run it at night without any problems. I can even listen to it while watching TV! There are several wash cycles, but I usually use the standard cycle (about 1 hour and 20 minutes). For greasy dishes, choose the intensive cycle, and for a quick rinse, choose the quick cycle. Having a wide range of options allows me to choose the right one for every situation, which is another huge advantage! 5. Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Since I only run it once a day, there was almost no difference in the electricity bill. I always run the water all the way through when I wash dishes, and it actually saves a lot of water! They say it uses only about 1/3 of the water compared to washing by hand. But you have to add 5-6L of water! So, after each run, you have to refill the water right away? 6. Disappointing Points: I don't have any drawbacks with Gwangmyeongchat, but if I had to point out one, it's that because it uses heat to dry, there are times when a few water droplets remain in the plastic container. I leave the door slightly open and let it air dry, so it's not a big deal! 7. Overall: Honestly, since using this, I feel like I've escaped the dishwashing hell, and my stress has almost disappeared. I enjoy cooking home-cooked meals and running the dishwasher every day. After eating, I just do a quick wash, put the dishes in, and press a button. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Comments (English): Review of the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher! 1. Purchase Review: I'm a sucker for washing dishes, but I always tell myself I'll just take a quick break after dinner! Capacity: Since it's designed for 3 people, I was worried it might be too small for a 6-person kitchen, but it was perfect for our family of two! (Don't let anything touch the nozzle! Apparently, the sound changes if it does.) At first, I was skeptical that the machine would clean better than I could with a scrub brush, but it's much cleaner than I can handle. 4. Noise & Washing Time: It's quieter than I thought. There are several wash cycles, but I usually use the standard cycle (about 1 hour and 20 minutes). For greasy dishes, choose the intensive cycle, and for a quick rinse, choose the quick cycle. Having a wide range of options allows me to choose the right one for every situation, which is another huge advantage! 5. Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. They say it uses only about 1/3 of the water compared to washing by hand. But you have to add 5-6L of water! So, after each run, you have to refill the water right away? 6. Disappointing Points: I don't have any drawbacks with Gwangmyeongchat, but if I had to point out one, it's that because it uses heat to dry, there are times when a few water droplets remain in the plastic container. I leave the door slightly open and let it air dry, so it's not a big deal! 7. Overall: Honestly, since using this, I feel like I've escaped the dishwashing hell, and my stress has almost disappeared. I enjoy cooking home-cooked meals and running the dishwasher every day. After eating, I just do a quick wash, put the dishes in, and press a button. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Capacity: Since it's designed for 3 people, I was worried it might be too small for a 6-person kitchen, but it was perfect for our family of two! Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Comments (English): Review of the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher! 1. Purchase Review: I'm a sucker for washing dishes, but I always tell myself I'll just take a quick break after dinner! So, I finally bought the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher. This is truly a blessing! 2. Design: I love the clean, dark color. My kitchen is white, so I was worried the dark color would stand out, but it doesn't, and the size is comfortable! The fact that it's a direct-flow unit means no plumbing is a plus! No installation required. Just fill the tank with water and connect the drain pipe. Installation was stress-free. Follow the instructions and it's done in no time! 3. Capacity: Since it's designed for 3 people, I was worried it might be too small for a 6-person kitchen, but it was perfect for our family of two! It can fit two soup bowls, two rice bowls, chopsticks, and a cup, and more! If you play Tetris properly, it could even double. The nozzle rotates 360 degrees, ensuring thorough cleaning. (Don't let anything touch the nozzle! Apparently, the sound changes if it does.) At first, I was skeptical that the machine would clean better than I could with a scrub brush, but it's much cleaner than I can handle. 4. Noise & Washing Time: It's quieter than I thought. Of course, it's not completely silent, but it's quiet enough that I can run it at night without any problems. I can even listen to it while watching TV! There are several wash cycles, but I usually use the standard cycle (about 1 hour and 20 minutes). For greasy dishes, choose the intensive cycle, and for a quick rinse, choose the quick cycle. Having a wide range of options allows me to choose the right one for every situation, which is another huge advantage! 5. Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Since I only run it once a day, there was almost no difference in the electricity bill. I always run the water all the way through when I wash dishes, and it actually saves a lot of water! They say it uses only about 1/3 of the water compared to washing by hand. But you have to add 5-6L of water! So, after each run, you have to refill the water right away? 6. Disappointing Points: I don't have any drawbacks with Gwangmyeongchat, but if I had to point out one, it's that because it uses heat to dry, there are times when a few water droplets remain in the plastic container. I leave the door slightly open and let it air dry, so it's not a big deal! 7. Overall: Honestly, since using this, I feel like I've escaped the dishwashing hell, and my stress has almost disappeared. I enjoy cooking home-cooked meals and running the dishwasher every day. After eating, I just do a quick wash, put the dishes in, and press a button. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Disappointing Points: I don't have any drawbacks with Gwangmyeongchat, but if I had to point out one, it's that because it uses heat to dry, there are times when a few water droplets remain in the plastic container. I leave the door slightly open and let it air dry, so it's not a big deal! 7. Overall: Honestly, since using this, I feel like I've escaped the dishwashing hell, and my stress has almost disappeared. I enjoy cooking home-cooked meals and running the dishwasher every day. After eating, I just do a quick wash, put the dishes in, and press a button. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Comments (English): Review of the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher! 1. Purchase Review: I'm a sucker for washing dishes, but I always tell myself I'll just take a quick break after dinner! So, I finally bought the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher. This is truly a blessing! 2. Design: I love the clean, dark color. My kitchen is white, so I was worried the dark color would stand out, but it doesn't, and the size is comfortable! The fact that it's a direct-flow unit means no plumbing is a plus! No installation required. Just fill the tank with water and connect the drain pipe. Installation was stress-free. Follow the instructions and it's done in no time! 3. Capacity: Since it's designed for 3 people, I was worried it might be too small for a 6-person kitchen, but it was perfect for our family of two! It can fit two soup bowls, two rice bowls, chopsticks, and a cup, and more! If you play Tetris properly, it could even double. The nozzle rotates 360 degrees, ensuring thorough cleaning. (Don't let anything touch the nozzle! Apparently, the sound changes if it does.) At first, I was skeptical that the machine would clean better than I could with a scrub brush, but it's much cleaner than I can handle. 4. Noise & Washing Time: It's quieter than I thought. Of course, it's not completely silent, but it's quiet enough that I can run it at night without any problems. I can even listen to it while watching TV! There are several wash cycles, but I usually use the standard cycle (about 1 hour and 20 minutes). For greasy dishes, choose the intensive cycle, and for a quick rinse, choose the quick cycle. Having a wide range of options allows me to choose the right one for every situation, which is another huge advantage! 5. Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Since I only run it once a day, there was almost no difference in the electricity bill. I always run the water all the way through when I wash dishes, and it actually saves a lot of water! They say it uses only about 1/3 of the water compared to washing by hand. But you have to add 5-6L of water! So, after each run, you have to refill the water right away? 6. Disappointing Points: I don't have any drawbacks with Gwangmyeongchat, but if I had to point out one, it's that because it uses heat to dry, there are times when a few water droplets remain in the plastic container. I leave the door slightly open and let it air dry, so it's not a big deal! 7. Overall: Honestly, since using this, I feel like I've escaped the dishwashing hell, and my stress has almost disappeared. I enjoy cooking home-cooked meals and running the dishwasher every day. After eating, I just do a quick wash, put the dishes in, and press a button. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Comments (English): Review of the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher! 1. Purchase Review: I'm a sucker for washing dishes, but I always tell myself I'll just take a quick break after dinner! But I end up putting it off until nighttime. It's okay since there are only a few cups, plates, and chopsticks, but the piles get stressful. So, I finally bought the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher. This is truly a blessing! 2. Design: I love the clean, dark color. My kitchen is white, so I was worried the dark color would stand out, but it doesn't, and the size is comfortable! The fact that it's a direct-flow unit means no plumbing is a plus! No installation required. Just fill the tank with water and connect the drain pipe. Installation was stress-free. Follow the instructions and it's done in no time! 3. Capacity: Since it's designed for 3 people, I was worried it might be too small for a 6-person kitchen, but it was perfect for our family of two! It can fit two soup bowls, two rice bowls, chopsticks, and a cup, and more! If you play Tetris properly, it could even double. The nozzle rotates 360 degrees, ensuring thorough cleaning. (Don't let anything touch the nozzle! Apparently, the sound changes if it does.) At first, I was skeptical that the machine would clean better than I could with a scrub brush, but it's much cleaner than I can handle. 4. Noise & Washing Time: It's quieter than I thought. Of course, it's not completely silent, but it's quiet enough that I can run it at night without any problems. I can even listen to it while watching TV! There are several wash cycles, but I usually use the standard cycle (about 1 hour and 20 minutes). For greasy dishes, choose the intensive cycle, and for a quick rinse, choose the quick cycle. Having a wide range of options allows me to choose the right one for every situation, which is another huge advantage! 5. Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Since I only run it once a day, there was almost no difference in the electricity bill. I always run the water all the way through when I wash dishes, and it actually saves a lot of water! They say it uses only about 1/3 of the water compared to washing by hand. But you have to add 5-6L of water! So, after each run, you have to refill the water right away? 6. Disappointing Points: I don't have any drawbacks with Gwangmyeongchat, but if I had to point out one, it's that because it uses heat to dry, there are times when a few water droplets remain in the plastic container. I leave the door slightly open and let it air dry, so it's not a big deal! 7. Overall: Honestly, since using this, I feel like I've escaped the dishwashing hell, and my stress has almost disappeared. I enjoy cooking home-cooked meals and running the dishwasher every day. After eating, I just do a quick wash, put the dishes in, and press a button. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Sentence (English): Overall: Honestly, since using this, I feel like I've escaped the dishwashing hell, and my stress has almost disappeared.
Comments (English): Review of the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher! 1. Purchase Review: I'm a sucker for washing dishes, but I always tell myself I'll just take a quick break after dinner! But I end up putting it off until nighttime. It's okay since there are only a few cups, plates, and chopsticks, but the piles get stressful. So, I finally bought the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher. This is truly a blessing! 2. Design: I love the clean, dark color. My kitchen is white, so I was worried the dark color would stand out, but it doesn't, and the size is comfortable! The fact that it's a direct-flow unit means no plumbing is a plus! No installation required. Just fill the tank with water and connect the drain pipe. Installation was stress-free. Follow the instructions and it's done in no time! 3. Capacity: Since it's designed for 3 people, I was worried it might be too small for a 6-person kitchen, but it was perfect for our family of two! It can fit two soup bowls, two rice bowls, chopsticks, and a cup, and more! If you play Tetris properly, it could even double. The nozzle rotates 360 degrees, ensuring thorough cleaning. (Don't let anything touch the nozzle! Apparently, the sound changes if it does.) At first, I was skeptical that the machine would clean better than I could with a scrub brush, but it's much cleaner than I can handle. 4. Noise & Washing Time: It's quieter than I thought. Of course, it's not completely silent, but it's quiet enough that I can run it at night without any problems. I can even listen to it while watching TV! There are several wash cycles, but I usually use the standard cycle (about 1 hour and 20 minutes). For greasy dishes, choose the intensive cycle, and for a quick rinse, choose the quick cycle. Having a wide range of options allows me to choose the right one for every situation, which is another huge advantage! 5. Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Since I only run it once a day, there was almost no difference in the electricity bill. I always run the water all the way through when I wash dishes, and it actually saves a lot of water! They say it uses only about 1/3 of the water compared to washing by hand. But you have to add 5-6L of water! So, after each run, you have to refill the water right away? 6. Disappointing Points: I don't have any drawbacks with Gwangmyeongchat, but if I had to point out one, it's that because it uses heat to dry, there are times when a few water droplets remain in the plastic container. I leave the door slightly open and let it air dry, so it's not a big deal! 7. Overall: Honestly, since using this, I feel like I've escaped the dishwashing hell, and my stress has almost disappeared. I enjoy cooking home-cooked meals and running the dishwasher every day. After eating, I just do a quick wash, put the dishes in, and press a button. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Sentence (English): Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential!
Comments (English): Review of the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher! 1. Purchase Review: I'm a sucker for washing dishes, but I always tell myself I'll just take a quick break after dinner! But I end up putting it off until nighttime. It's okay since there are only a few cups, plates, and chopsticks, but the piles get stressful. So, I finally bought the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher. This is truly a blessing! 2. Design: I love the clean, dark color. My kitchen is white, so I was worried the dark color would stand out, but it doesn't, and the size is comfortable! The fact that it's a direct-flow unit means no plumbing is a plus! No installation required. Just fill the tank with water and connect the drain pipe. Installation was stress-free. Follow the instructions and it's done in no time! 3. Capacity: Since it's designed for 3 people, I was worried it might be too small for a 6-person kitchen, but it was perfect for our family of two! It can fit two soup bowls, two rice bowls, chopsticks, and a cup, and more! If you play Tetris properly, it could even double. The nozzle rotates 360 degrees, ensuring thorough cleaning. (Don't let anything touch the nozzle! Apparently, the sound changes if it does.) At first, I was skeptical that the machine would clean better than I could with a scrub brush, but it's much cleaner than I can handle. 4. Noise & Washing Time: It's quieter than I thought. Of course, it's not completely silent, but it's quiet enough that I can run it at night without any problems. I can even listen to it while watching TV! There are several wash cycles, but I usually use the standard cycle (about 1 hour and 20 minutes). For greasy dishes, choose the intensive cycle, and for a quick rinse, choose the quick cycle. Having a wide range of options allows me to choose the right one for every situation, which is another huge advantage! 5. Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Since I only run it once a day, there was almost no difference in the electricity bill. I always run the water all the way through when I wash dishes, and it actually saves a lot of water! They say it uses only about 1/3 of the water compared to washing by hand. But you have to add 5-6L of water! So, after each run, you have to refill the water right away? 6. Disappointing Points: I don't have any drawbacks with Gwangmyeongchat, but if I had to point out one, it's that because it uses heat to dry, there are times when a few water droplets remain in the plastic container. I leave the door slightly open and let it air dry, so it's not a big deal! 7. Overall: Honestly, since using this, I feel like I've escaped the dishwashing hell, and my stress has almost disappeared. I enjoy cooking home-cooked meals and running the dishwasher every day. After eating, I just do a quick wash, put the dishes in, and press a button. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Comments (English): Review of the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher! 1. Purchase Review: I'm a sucker for washing dishes, but I always tell myself I'll just take a quick break after dinner! So, I finally bought the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher. This is truly a blessing! 2. Design: I love the clean, dark color. My kitchen is white, so I was worried the dark color would stand out, but it doesn't, and the size is comfortable! The fact that it's a direct-flow unit means no plumbing is a plus! Capacity: Since it's designed for 3 people, I was worried it might be too small for a 6-person kitchen, but it was perfect for our family of two! (Don't let anything touch the nozzle! Apparently, the sound changes if it does.) At first, I was skeptical that the machine would clean better than I could with a scrub brush, but it's much cleaner than I can handle. 4. Noise & Washing Time: It's quieter than I thought. Of course, it's not completely silent, but it's quiet enough that I can run it at night without any problems. I can even listen to it while watching TV! There are several wash cycles, but I usually use the standard cycle (about 1 hour and 20 minutes). For greasy dishes, choose the intensive cycle, and for a quick rinse, choose the quick cycle. Having a wide range of options allows me to choose the right one for every situation, which is another huge advantage! 5. Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Since I only run it once a day, there was almost no difference in the electricity bill. I always run the water all the way through when I wash dishes, and it actually saves a lot of water! They say it uses only about 1/3 of the water compared to washing by hand. But you have to add 5-6L of water! So, after each run, you have to refill the water right away? 6. Disappointing Points: I don't have any drawbacks with Gwangmyeongchat, but if I had to point out one, it's that because it uses heat to dry, there are times when a few water droplets remain in the plastic container. I leave the door slightly open and let it air dry, so it's not a big deal! 7. Overall: Honestly, since using this, I feel like I've escaped the dishwashing hell, and my stress has almost disappeared. I enjoy cooking home-cooked meals and running the dishwasher every day. After eating, I just do a quick wash, put the dishes in, and press a button. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Sentence (English): Highly recommended!
Comments (English): Review of the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher! 1. Purchase Review: I'm a sucker for washing dishes, but I always tell myself I'll just take a quick break after dinner! But I end up putting it off until nighttime. It's okay since there are only a few cups, plates, and chopsticks, but the piles get stressful. So, I finally bought the MINIX PRO 3-Person Mini Dishwasher. This is truly a blessing! 2. Design: I love the clean, dark color. My kitchen is white, so I was worried the dark color would stand out, but it doesn't, and the size is comfortable! The fact that it's a direct-flow unit means no plumbing is a plus! No installation required. Just fill the tank with water and connect the drain pipe. Installation was stress-free. Follow the instructions and it's done in no time! 3. Capacity: Since it's designed for 3 people, I was worried it might be too small for a 6-person kitchen, but it was perfect for our family of two! It can fit two soup bowls, two rice bowls, chopsticks, and a cup, and more! If you play Tetris properly, it could even double. The nozzle rotates 360 degrees, ensuring thorough cleaning. (Don't let anything touch the nozzle! Apparently, the sound changes if it does.) At first, I was skeptical that the machine would clean better than I could with a scrub brush, but it's much cleaner than I can handle. 4. Noise & Washing Time: It's quieter than I thought. Of course, it's not completely silent, but it's quiet enough that I can run it at night without any problems. I can even listen to it while watching TV! There are several wash cycles, but I usually use the standard cycle (about 1 hour and 20 minutes). For greasy dishes, choose the intensive cycle, and for a quick rinse, choose the quick cycle. Having a wide range of options allows me to choose the right one for every situation, which is another huge advantage! 5. Electricity & Water Usage: At first, I was worried about the high electricity bill, but it actually turned out to be less of a burden than I thought. Since I only run it once a day, there was almost no difference in the electricity bill. I always run the water all the way through when I wash dishes, and it actually saves a lot of water! They say it uses only about 1/3 of the water compared to washing by hand. But you have to add 5-6L of water! So, after each run, you have to refill the water right away? 6. Disappointing Points: I don't have any drawbacks with Gwangmyeongchat, but if I had to point out one, it's that because it uses heat to dry, there are times when a few water droplets remain in the plastic container. I leave the door slightly open and let it air dry, so it's not a big deal! 7. Overall: Honestly, since using this, I feel like I've escaped the dishwashing hell, and my stress has almost disappeared. I enjoy cooking home-cooked meals and running the dishwasher every day. After eating, I just do a quick wash, put the dishes in, and press a button. Since I can do other things during that time, I save time! Dishwashers aren't just luxuries these days; they're essential! If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a single or two-person household, and you're hesitant like me, definitely consider the Minix Mini Dishwasher! It's really good! Highly recommended!

Sentence (English): In spite of the many positive reviews, my recommendation is Do Not Buy this product!
Comments (English): [ Not Usually a Complainer…… ] || ---------------- || In spite of the many positive reviews, my recommendation is Do Not Buy this product! We previously had a Bosch 800 that we really liked but it was replacement time. We went to a big box store and the Bosch rep was there by chance and recommended this unit as it was significantly less expensive and had free installation. Bottom line is the dishes simply did not come clean and everything inside was soaking wet, even when running it on Extra Dry. You shouldn't have to hand wash dishes before putting them into a dishwasher in order for them to come out clean. Furthermore you shouldn't have to towel dry every item before you can put the them away. Especially paying 1200 dollars. We did an exchange and upgraded to the 800 which has crystal dry (works extremely well) and is so quiet you can't tell it's running. To add insult to injury, we had to pay for installation on the replacement because the box store said it was a Bosch promotion and they wouldn't honor it on the replacement. So bottom line is we paid a lot more for the 800 and are thrilled with it. Just skip over the economy route, don't buy the 300 and save yourself the aggravation of exchanges.

Sentence (English): The water flow is much weaker than expected.
Comments (English): The water flow is much weaker than expected. Even after drying with hot air, the dishes do not dry properly. The two-tier basket is too big, so only 2-3 large plates can fit on the first tier, and even if it is not a large plate, the bottom of the two-tier basket cannot hold anything other than very small plates, so it is not very practical. The cutlery holder is too small, and when you put a spoon in the spoon holder and turn it, the water flow is only slightly towards the spoon. In other words, although I was not able to check the interior in detail while washing, I think the corners and edges are not cleaned. The shelves in the basket are too narrow, so it is difficult to put in anything other than flat dishes. The product page says that the middle washing blade is attached to the wall, but it is actually installed in the upper basket. It is said that the upper basket can be separated and washed during installation, but when the basket is separated, the washing blade detaches and water continues to flow out from that side, so the water flow from the other washing blades is so weak that it hardly washes at all. Saying you can wash this separately is just nonsense. If I use a lot of rice bowls and small soup bowls, a two-tier basket might not be too inconvenient, but since we usually use a lot of plates, a single-tier dishwasher would be better. The compact size is an advantage compared to a single-tier dishwasher. Plus, there don't seem to be many dishwashers these days that have hot air drying and UV protection, so if you want both, you have no choice.

Sentence (English): The good… I like the appearance of the dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Looks great ] || ---------------- || The good… I like the appearance of the dishwasher. The flush aspect of the door is great. I find the controls reasonably easy to access. The stainless steel interior is nice. I like having the top pullout that you can put glasses and silverware in.The not so good… Most concerning is that I don't believe this unit cleans well. It replaced a 20-year-old dishwasher which I believe did a better a job of cleaning. The silverware caddy is way too big. It spans virtually front to back on one side. That might work well when dealing with holiday dishes/silverware but not week to week or every day cleaning. It's just way too large and takes up too much room. If they made the caddy a two-part piece where it could separate in the center to be used for high volume or low volume that would be perfect. I fortunately saved the basket from my old dishwasher and have been using that instead (rather than give it to Goodwill! ). There is not an indicator on the panel to identify when the rinse aid is low. That's a bit of a guessing game. Unfortunately, the unit does not have an energy saver selection. That was quite surprising and something I didn't notice at the showroom. I assumed it to be a standard feature these days. So I have to select normal wash and de-select heat dry. I'm not certain that it actually shuts off the heat dry. However, when I select express wash as an energy saver option, which doesn't have a heat dry the amount of water inside of the unit is substantial! My old unit had an energy saver and the water left inside the unit after the cycle was minimal. It is quite the opposite with this unit. Surprisingly, I think this dishwasher holds less than my old dishwasher. I'm not certain why, but I can't seem to stack as many dishes as I did before. My suspicion is that the unit is smaller front to back. Despite having three shelves, I'm not getting as many dishes in the unit for one cycle. When you have the full silverware caddy in the unit, forget it! It just takes up so much space you lose a lot for your dishes. All in all would I buy it again? I think I would do a few more comparisons, but this unit had features that were not non-negotiable, and that is why I selected this unit. I am disappointed in its performance, the caddy, and some of the missing cycle options that would've been beneficial.

Sentence (English): In 2006 I experienced my first Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ My dream dishwasher ] || ---------------- || In 2006 I experienced my first Bosch dishwasher. I swore one day I would get one. That day came! I must admit, I am a little let down. While the noise level is uber quiet, and the sleek stainless is flawless, there are a few things I dont love. 1. There is much less room inside compared to my old machine. 2. The cutlery basket is also quite small. 3. The pegs that hold the dishes are odd. Understanding they are arranged that way to optimize cleaning, it makes it difficult to load. 4. Instructions say dont prewash. But the food baked on when I didnt prewash. 5. There is no delay setting on the door. There is an app that is supposed to have a delay, but the dishwasher kept sending updates to my tv interupting my show. Deleted app. 6. On normal, it is a 3 hour cycle. So the last one out of the shower has to remember to turn on the dishwasher. For the price, I am a bit let down. But it seems like a solid machine. I do like the adjustable rack, but have not had to adjust it yet. Hopefully the Bosch build quality will make this purchase worth it.

Sentence (English): The water flow is much weaker than expected.
Comments (English): The water flow is much weaker than expected. Even after drying with hot air, the dishes do not dry properly. The two-tier basket is too big, so only 2-3 large plates can fit on the first tier, and even if it is not a large plate, the bottom of the two-tier basket cannot hold anything other than very small plates, so it is not very practical. The cutlery holder is too small, and when you put a spoon in the spoon holder and turn it, the water flow is only slightly towards the spoon. In other words, although I was not able to check the interior in detail while washing, I think the corners and edges are not cleaned. The shelves in the basket are too narrow, so it is difficult to put in anything other than flat dishes. The product page says that the middle washing blade is attached to the wall, but it is actually installed in the upper basket. It is said that the upper basket can be separated and washed during installation, but when the basket is separated, the washing blade detaches and water continues to flow out from that side, so the water flow from the other washing blades is so weak that it hardly washes at all. Saying that you can wash this separately is just nonsense. If I use a lot of rice bowls and small soup bowls, a two-tier basket might not be too inconvenient, but since we usually use a lot of plates, a single-tier dishwasher would be better. The compact size compared to a single-tier is an advantage. Also, it seems that there aren't many dishwashers these days that have hot air drying and UV protection, so if you want both, you have no choice.

Sentence (English): The good… I like the appearance of the dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Looks great ] || ---------------- || The good… I like the appearance of the dishwasher. The flush aspect of the door is great. I find the controls reasonably easy to access. The stainless steel interior is nice. I like having the top pullout that you can put glasses and silverware in. The not so good… Most concerning is that I don't believe this unit cleans well. It replaced a 20-year-old dishwasher which I believe did a better a job of cleaning. The silverware caddy is way too big. It spans virtually front to back on one side. That might work well when dealing with holiday dishes/silverware but not week to week or every day cleaning. It's just way too large and takes up too much room. If they made the caddy a two-part piece where it could separate in the center to be used for high volume or low volume that would be perfect. I fortunately saved the basket from my old dishwasher and have been using that instead (rather than give it to Goodwill! ). There is not an indicator on the panel to identify when the rinse aid is low. That's a bit of a guessing game. Unfortunately, the unit does not have an energy saver selection. That was quite surprising and something I didn't notice at the showroom. I assumed it to be a standard feature these days. So I have to select normal wash and de-select heat dry. I'm not certain that it actually shuts off the heat dry. However, when I select express wash as an energy saver option, which doesn't have a heat dry the amount of water inside of the unit is substantial! My old unit had an energy saver and the water left inside the unit after the cycle was minimal. It is quite the opposite with this unit. Surprisingly, I think this dishwasher holds less than my old dishwasher. I'm not certain why, but I can't seem to stack as many dishes as I did before. My suspicion is that the unit is smaller front to back. Despite having three shelves, I'm not getting as many dishes in the unit for one cycle. When you have the full silverware caddy in the unit, forget it! It just takes up so much space you lose a lot for your dishes. All in all would I buy it again? I think I would do a few more comparisons, but this unit had features that were not non-negotiable, and that is why I selected this unit. I am disappointed in its performance, the caddy, and some of the missing cycle options that would've been beneficial.

Sentence (English): I'm so so satisfied!
Comments (English): I'm so so satisfied! I ordered a Samsung BESPOKE countertop dishwasher (6-person). After the holidays, my husband recommended that I buy a dishwasher. I remembered my nephews who recommended it to me, saying it was a new world, so I pretended not to be able to resist and begged them to buy it for me. Wow~~~ It's so convenient, and when I saw that the dishes came out cleaner than when I did them myself, I wondered why I bought it sooner~~ I bought a 6-person one because my kitchen isn't that big. It might be a little small if there are a lot of family members gathered for the holidays, but it's enough for a family of 3 on a regular basis~~ It has a regular wash function, but it also has a quick wash function, so you can save electricity and water by using each function. It opens automatically to cool down after it's finished, and it's convenient because the dishes are dried. The installers were also very friendly. I highly recommend it~~!

Sentence (English): Samsung is the answer!
Comments (English): Samsung is the answer! A review of the BESPOKE countertop dishwasher, offering both neatness and convenience (made with my own money). Among my three aunts, I finally got a dishwasher. My old one broke, so I was just hand-washing for a while, but it was incredibly inconvenient. So, after a quick search, I settled on the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher, which I loved for both its design and functionality. The white color blends perfectly with my kitchen decor, and its compact size offers ample storage space. The Samsung technician came, and the installation was seamless and the instructions were helpful, so I was in a good mood. As expected, Samsung's reputation for excellent service is well-deserved. The auto-opening feature is a real bonus! My old dishwasher required me to open the door after each wash, which was inconvenient. This one automatically opens slightly after each wash, allowing steam to escape and drying much more efficiently. The clean, elegant white BESPOKE design makes it a perfect addition to any kitchen. The bottle sterilization function makes it perfect for homes with babies. The high-temperature sterilization makes it safe to clean glass bottles and baby food containers. The wine glass cleaning power is truly amazing. My husband loves to enjoy a glass of wine after work, and he was so happy to see his wine glasses sparkle like glass after washing them. It's quiet and runs quietly, so I don't mind running it at night. Disadvantages: Because of the limited space, you need to carefully check the height of your sink before ordering. The internal basket is a bit tight, so it might be difficult to clean large pots. Overall Review: Thanks to the Samsung BESPOKE dishwasher, I no longer have to worry about washing dishes. It's beautifully designed, features smart functionality, and the cleaning power is impeccable. The auto-opening and sterilizing functions are especially impressive, making me think, "Samsung is the way to go!" Every time I take out my dishes, they sparkle clean, I feel great. Among my three aunts, I finally got a dishwasher. My old one broke, so I was just hand-washing for a while, but it was incredibly inconvenient. So, after a quick search, I settled on the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher, which I loved for both its design and functionality. The white color blends perfectly with my kitchen decor, and its compact size offers ample storage space. The Samsung technician came, and the installation was seamless and the instructions were helpful, so I was in a good mood. As expected, Samsung's reputation for excellent service is well-deserved. The auto-opening feature is a real bonus! My old dishwasher required me to open the door after each wash, which was inconvenient. This one automatically opens slightly after each wash, allowing steam to escape and drying much more efficiently. The clean, elegant white BESPOKE design makes it a perfect addition to any kitchen. The bottle sterilization function makes it perfect for homes with babies. The high-temperature sterilization makes it safe to clean glass bottles and baby food containers. The wine glass cleaning power is truly amazing. My husband loves to enjoy a glass of wine after work, and he was so happy to see his wine glasses sparkle like glass after washing them. It's quiet and runs quietly, so I don't mind running it at night. Disadvantages: Because of the limited space, you need to carefully check the height of your sink before ordering. The internal basket is a bit tight, so it might be difficult to clean large pots. Overall Review: Thanks to the Samsung BESPOKE dishwasher, I no longer have to worry about washing dishes. It's beautifully designed, features smart functionality, and the cleaning power is impeccable. The auto-opening and sterilizing functions are especially impressive, making me think, "Samsung is the way to go!" Every time I take out my dishes, they sparkle clean, I feel great. Overall Review: 5 out of 5! The cleanliness, cleaning power, design, and functionality are all impressive, and my kitchen has become much more sophisticated. In short, I'll never go back to washing dishes by hand again!

Among my three aunts, I finally got a dishwasher. My old one broke, so I was just hand-washing for a while, but it was incredibly inconvenient. The auto-opening and sterilizing functions are especially impressive, making me think, "Samsung is the way to go!" Every time I take out my dishes, they sparkle clean, I feel great. Overall Review: 5 out of 5! The cleanliness, cleaning power, design, and functionality are all impressive, and my kitchen has become much more sophisticated. In short, I'll never go back to washing dishes by hand again!

Among my three aunts, I finally got a dishwasher. My old one broke, so I was just hand-washing for a while, but it was incredibly inconvenient. So, after a quick search, I settled on the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher, which I loved for both its design and functionality. The white color blends perfectly with my kitchen decor, and its compact size offers ample storage space. The Samsung technician came, and the installation was seamless and the instructions were helpful, so I was in a good mood. As expected, Samsung's reputation for excellent service is well-deserved. The auto-opening feature is a real bonus! My old dishwasher required me to open the door after each wash, which was inconvenient. This one automatically opens slightly after each wash, allowing steam to escape and drying much more efficiently. The clean, elegant white BESPOKE design makes it a perfect addition to any kitchen. The bottle sterilization function makes it perfect for homes with babies. The high-temperature sterilization makes it safe to clean glass bottles and baby food containers. It's beautifully designed, features smart functionality, and the cleaning power is impeccable. The auto-opening and sterilizing functions are especially impressive, making me think, "Samsung is the way to go!" Every time I take out my dishes, they sparkle clean, I feel great. Overall Review: 5 out of 5! The cleanliness, cleaning power, design, and functionality are all impressive, and my kitchen has become much more sophisticated. In short, I'll never go back to washing dishes by hand again!

Among my three aunts, I finally got a dishwasher. My old one broke, so I was just hand-washing for a while, but it was incredibly inconvenient. So, after a quick search, I settled on the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher, which I loved for both its design and functionality. The white color blends perfectly with my kitchen decor, and its compact size offers ample storage space. The Samsung technician came, and the installation was seamless and the instructions were helpful, so I was in a good mood. As expected, Samsung's reputation for excellent service is well-deserved. The auto-opening feature is a real bonus! My old dishwasher required me to open the door after each wash, which was inconvenient. This one automatically opens slightly after each wash, allowing steam to escape and drying much more efficiently. The clean, elegant white BESPOKE design makes it a perfect addition to any kitchen. The bottle sterilization function makes it perfect for homes with babies. The high-temperature sterilization makes it safe to clean glass bottles and baby food containers. The wine glass cleaning power is truly amazing. My husband loves to enjoy a glass of wine after work, and he was so happy to see his wine glasses sparkle like glass after washing them. It's quiet and runs quietly, so I don't mind running it at night. Disadvantages: Because of the limited space, you need to carefully check the height of your sink before ordering. The internal basket is a bit tight, so it might be difficult to clean large pots. Overall Review: Thanks to the Samsung BESPOKE dishwasher, I no longer have to worry about washing dishes. It's beautifully designed, features smart functionality, and the cleaning power is impeccable. The auto-opening and sterilizing functions are especially impressive, making me think, "Samsung is the way to go!" Every time I take out my dishes, they sparkle clean, I feel great. Overall Review: 5 out of 5! The cleanliness, cleaning power, design, and functionality are all impressive, and my kitchen has become much more sophisticated. In short, I'll never go back to washing dishes by hand again!

Sentence (English): This is the most unreliable product I have ever encountered.
Comments (English): [ Do not get this piece of junk ] || ---------------- || This is the most unreliable product I have ever encountered. I purchased in February of 2023, so now the unit is 18 months old.Pretty soon after installation, it stop making a sound on button push. But was still working, so we moved on Then, at about 12 months, the door to dispense detergent stopped opening. We had purchased the extended warranty, so they sent us someone from a company called Bodewell to fix it. However, they were unable to send replacement parts that weren't already broken. We had a month long stretch where I had to take time off work, wait for the technician to show up, then he would open the part and see that it was obviously cracked. Eventually after about a month of this the dishwasher was able to be repaired. They had to replace the control board too because it had shorted out.Then, one month ago, the door started leaking. Now I'm going through the same process - bodewell sent a technician out, and had to order a replacement door panel. Once that arrived, I had another appointment, just to find out that they sent the wrong door panel. Now they have shipped another one, but I have been waiting two weeks for an appointment, with no indication that they have actually shipped the correct panel. So, in 18 months total of owning the dishwasher, I estimate it has been functional for 12 of them. And I have had to take time off work for about 10 different service appointments. On top of that, Bodewell (which appears to be GE's official service brand), communicates very poorly. When you call, you are stuck in various phone trees, and it is nearly impossible to get a person on the line. I tried to ask for a replacement per the warranty, but it must be declared “unrepairable” by the service technician. But I think they have proven they do not have the capability to repair it, which includes a supply chain to deliver replacement parts in working condition and available technicians. This is unacceptable.
